evidence.heading: ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: The Allstate Arena strives to provide excellent service to all our guests, including those guests with special needs. Allstate Arena recognizes the needs of persons with disabilities and meets or exceeds the requirements for compliance with the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA). Allstate Arena provides a full range of accommodations for guests with disabilities to ensure their safety, comfort and enjoyment of our events and facilities. The following section highlights our services.

evidence.heading: ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Accessible/Disabled seating is available on the lower level of the arena. Wheelchair area is located behind sections 113 and 116 (depending on event set-up behind sections 105 and 108 may also be available). Wheelchairs must purchase a ticket to these areas only. There is no access to main floor or other seating areas. If you can walk with assistance tickets can be purchased in any section but wheelchair can’t be stored at or near your seat. Tickets for accessible seating areas are available through Ticketmaster and the Allstate Arena Box Office. When ordering tickets for an accessible seating area, it is important to indicate that you require accessible seating so we can properly seat you. Please note that the number of seats available in the accessible seating area meets the requirements of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) and other laws relating to accessibility, however, the number of seats in the accessible seating areas is limited. Tickets for seats in the accessible seating areas are sold on a first come, first served basis.

evidence.heading: ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Allstate Arena provides complimentary wheelchair escorts to guests with special needs when requested. Escorts are available at any entry point. Please be aware that our staff will not remain with you during the event, nor will they allow you to remain in the wheelchair for the duration of the event.

evidence.heading: Arena FAQ's
evidence.text: Animals are not permitted inside of the building, with the exception of service animals and service animals in training to aid guests with disabilities. Pursuant to applicable law, a service animal must be a dog that is individually trained to do work or perform tasks directly related to an individual’s disability for the benefit of such individual with a disability. Service animals do not include emotional support or comfort animals, which are prohibited. Service animals are welcome inside of the building, but must remain on a leash or in a harness at all times. While not necessary, we encourage guests attending any event with service animals to contact American Airlines Center’s Guest Services Department at 214-665-4299 in advance of the event day so that we may better accommodate the needs of the guest and his/her service animal. evidence.heading: Carry-in Policy
evidence.text: Fans are encouraged to limit their carry-in items in the interest of expediting the entry process for all fans. To enhance ballpark safety and expedite the security screening process. American Family Field is prohibiting multi-compartment bags and implementing a single-compartment bag policy. Non-clear bags 9” x 5” x 2” or smaller, clear single-compartment bags 12” x 12” x 6” or smaller, and one-gallon clear resealable bags will be allowed. Exceptions will be made for diaper bags (maximum size: 16” x 16” x 8”) and for ADA/medically necessary items.

evidence.heading: Fan Screening
evidence.text: In accordance with MLB policy, all fans will be required to go through metal detector screening, via walkthrough and/or handheld detectors prior to being granted access to American Family Field. Non-clear bags 9” x 5” x 2” or smaller, clear single-compartment bags 12” x 12” x 6” or smaller, and one-gallon clear resealable bags will be allowed. Exceptions will be made for diaper bags (maximum size: 16” x 16” x 8”) and for ADA/medically necessary items.

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: Fans can purchase a general parking pass in advance and access any of the accessible parking areas. Please visit brewers.com/ADA to review the Brewers Access Guide for guests with disabilities. ADA parking stalls are filled on a first come, first serve basis. Parking personnel will park guests in the closest available spaces once ADA stalls are filled.

evidence.heading: Parking Lot Policies
evidence.text: Approved shuttle services may use the drop-off area near the Ticket Office/Home Plate Gate accessible via Yount Drive or west of the ballpark near the accessible bus drop-off. Unauthorized vehicles are prohibited to park/drop-off in these areas and may be ticketed and/or towed.

evidence.heading: Onsite Courtesy Shuttles presented by Aurora Health Care®
evidence.text: Courtesy shuttles are available for guests needing assistance at select pick-up locations around the American Family Field grounds. Please see the American Family Field Parking Map for Courtesy Shuttle locations. Shuttles will only pick up from these locations and drop guests at the nearest entrance to American Family Field. After games, shuttles will pick up guests who need assistance at the Robin Yount Statue on the Home Plate Plaza and next to the UW Credit Union Plaza Gate on the Center Field Plaza and return them to the original pick-up locations. Expect longer wait times on day games and highly attended games. This is a free service; tipping is not permitted.

evidence.heading: Bicycle Parking
evidence.text: Bicycle racks are located near Helfaer Field, the Left Field Gate entrance, the Club Express entrance, and the Clock Tower entrance.

evidence.heading: Autograph Sundays presented by efrutti
evidence.text: Every Sunday home game from April through August, kids ages 14 and under are invited to meet and receive an autograph from a Brewers player, alumni and/or other Brewers personality from 11:50 a.m. – 12:10 p.m. at designated locations, which will be posted on the scoreboard when gates open. Player lineup and autograph times are subject to change. Autographs are limited to one per child and full-sized bats or other prohibited carry-in items are not allowed. Children needing assistance in accessing the autograph signings should visit the Guest Relations kiosk on the Field Level near Section 116 with their parent/guardian. A Guest Relations staff member will assist children in accessing the field.

evidence.heading: Batting Practice
evidence.text: Fans are invited to watch batting practice from their seats once American Family Field gates open (please find details listed under “Gate Opening Times”). Batting practice is subject to cancellation without notice. For your safety, please do not lean on or over railings or nets to catch baseballs at any time, and please be aware of bats and balls that may enter the seating areas at any time players and/or coaches are on the field. Please find details listed under “Policies Relating to Guest Conduct” for information on the Flying Balls and Flying Bats policy.

evidence.heading: Designated Driver
evidence.text: As part of our commitment to fan safety, we have partnered with Miller Lite, Delaware North, and Interstate Parking to implement a Designated Driver program at American Family Field. To register, the driver of a vehicle parked in the American Family Field lots must pledge not to consume alcoholic beverages while at American Family Field or in the American Family Field parking lots. The Designated Driver must be at least 21 years of age, have an American Family Field parking receipt or digital parking pass for that game, and a valid driver's license. The driver will receive one coupon for a complimentary soft drink. Participants may register at the Designated Driver kiosk located in the concourse behind Section 120 or at Brewers Guest Relations behind Section 419 from the time American Family Field gates open until one hour after the start of the game.

Another such example is the ‘Pompeii for All’ project with accessible and barrier-free paths providing improved access to the site to parents with buggies and mobility-impaired people.

evidence.text: The Angels strive to make every guest's visit to Angel Stadium enjoyable and accessible to persons with disabilities.

evidence.heading: Angel Stadium Segway Usage Policy
evidence.text: The Angels strive to make every guest's visit to Angel Stadium enjoyable and accessible to persons with disabilities. The Angels have established the following pilot policy regarding Segways and similar devices in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act ("ADA") and California State Law.

evidence.heading: Angel Stadium Segway Usage Policy
evidence.text: The Angels recommend that Segway users purchase tickets in one of the Stadium's accessible seating areas. Segway users may purchase tickets for up to 3 additional companion seats as outlined in the "Accessible Seating" for Guests with Disabilities section of the Angels' "A to Z Guide," including in the same seating locations as the wheelchair accessible seats. If more than one Segway guest will be in attendance together at a particular game, the Angels, at their sole discretion, may relocate users to the same section.

evidence.heading: Angel Stadium Segway Usage Policy
evidence.text: During games or events with high attendance and to the extent necessary for the safety of all guests, a Segway may be restricted to certain designated access points and areas. In such instances, Stadium personnel will designate areas that allow the Segway user to reach his or her accessible seats, designated restrooms, at least one team store (if the team stores are open for sales), at least one concession area (if the concession areas are open for service) and a Stadium entrance/exit.

evidence.heading: Angel Stadium Segway Usage Policy
evidence.text: Segway users must enter through the Home Plate Gate, or a second entrance, designated by the Angels. Only certain elevators will be available for use by Segway users. This policy does not permit the use of any Stadium escalators by Segway users.

evidence.heading: Venue Guide
evidence.text: To ensure a safe and secure experience, Ball Arena enforces a strict bag policy. Only small clutches, wristlets, and fanny packs measuring 4" x 6" x 1.5" or smaller are allowed. Purses and backpacks are not permitted. Medical and diaper bags no larger than 14" x 14" x 6" are allowed with proper inspection at designated entrances. ➡️ Click here to view the full bag policy. Bag Check with Binbox Lockers Located near the Infinity Sculpture and the Spires in the Grand Atrium (main entrance) Plaza. Pricing starts at $15 per checked bag which is non-refundable. Debit/credit and mobile payment, such as Apple or Google Pay, are acceptable forms of payment. Cash is not accepted. Ball Arena has a “No Re-Entry” policy for all events and bags stored in the lockers will not be accessible during the event. Bag check opens 30 minutes prior to general doors and closes 1-hour post-event. Bags remaining after that time will be brought to Lost & Found . Ball Arena, KSE, and its subsidiaries are not responsible for lost, stolen, broken or damaged items checked in to the Binbox lockers.

evidence.heading: Getting Here
evidence.text: Arriving by car The cost to park in lots closest to the stadium during events ranges from $10 to $30. There is limited accessible parking, however, there is a dedicated accessible drop-off located at street level on Pacific Boulevard under Gate F for guests using mobility devices. This entrance is commonly referred to as the “147 Accessible Entrance.”

evidence.heading: Getting Here
evidence.text: Accessing BC Place from the Stadium/Chinatown Skytrain Station: Upon exiting the Skytrain, walk up the stairs to Beatty Street and turn left. Gate A, B and H are approximately a five minute walk up Beatty Street. Alternatively, upon exiting the Skytrain head down the stairs to Expo Boulevard and the Stadium is a five minute walk to the right.

evidence.heading: Accessibility
evidence.text: Our accessible drop-off and pick-up area is located at section 147, just off Pacific Blvd across from Plaza of Nations. This entrance includes a ramp and direct elevator access to all floors. Please note, there is no parking in this area.

evidence.heading: Most Popular Questions
evidence.text: Bag check is typically located at Gate H for standard Vancouver Whitecaps FC and BC Lions games, or Lot 457 (off Pacific Blvd on Griffiths Way) for concerts and other full-stadium events. Locations may vary, so please check the specific event page for updates. The bag check service is available on a first-come-first-served basis at $10 per piece. Please note, bag storage is at the sole risk of the depositor. By accepting the bag check, the depositor releases the company and their employees from all liability for loss or damage.

evidence.heading: Accessibility
evidence.text: BC Place has a number of options to help get you around the stadium. evidence.heading: Where can I purchase tickets?
evidence.text: Tickets can be purchased on AXS.com or by clicking on "View Event Details" under the individual show on the upcoming events page. The Bellco Theatre box office is open on event days only, two hours prior to advertised show start time. Please note you will need an AXS account to purchase tickets. Tickets purchased at the outlet box office will include a nominal processing fee. Please note, if you do not already have an AXS account, please create one at AXS.com prior to purchasing tickets at the City of Denver outlet and provide the email used in creating the account at the window. Before arriving at the box office, it is recommended that you check for primary ticket availability by deselecting "Premium" and "Resale" on AXS.com to ensure ticket availability, but not guaranteed. For general ticketing questions, please contact support.axs.com .

evidence.heading: What time does the box office open?

evidence.heading: Is there a lost and found?
evidence.text: Yes, the lost and found during the performance and up to an hour past performance is located in the Box Office. For lost and found post performance, please call the Colorado Convention Center Lost and Found line at (303) 228-8066.

evidence.heading: Assisted Listening Devices
evidence.text: Assisted listening devices are available at no charge at the Bellco Theatre box office. The Bellco Theatre offers state-of-the-art Auracast with Bluetooth capability that allows the audio source to broadcast sound to an unlimited number of compatible devices, including smartphones with Bluetooth-connected hearing aids. Please note the broadcast range is limited to the theatre seating area only and will not be broadcast in the lobby nor elsewhere in the building. For attendees with older devices or who do not have a Bluetooth capability, we also offer pocket-sized receivers with earphones or loop options. Valid identification, such as a driver’s license, is required as a deposit to ensure return of the equipment. Please visit the Bellco Theatre box office for assistance.

evidence.heading: Directions to the Bellco Theatre

evidence.heading: General Accommodations
evidence.text: Free limited accessible parking for guests with mobility impairments with a valid disability placard or other authorized identification is available in the drop-off circle adjacent to the Museum, located at 200 Hurd Road. There is free overflow accessible parking for guests with mobility impairments with proper state identification across Hurd Road in Lots C and D. Please note accessible parking spaces are available on a first come, first served basis. On Pavilion concert days, transportation assistance from the Transportation Assistance Depot located in Lot D to the Museum and into the concert venue may be available—ask the parking attendant about availability.

evidence.heading: General Accommodations
evidence.text: Trained service animals are ALWAYS welcome at Bethel Woods Center for the Arts. Emotional support animals, comfort animals and therapy dogs are not permitted at Bethel Woods, as per Title III of the ADA. Consistent with ADA guidelines, Bethel Woods defines “service animal” as limited to a dog that is individually trained to work or perform tasks for an individual with a disability. The task(s) performed by the dog must be directly related to the individual’s disability. Bethel Woods requires, consistent with ADA, that service animals must be harnessed, leashed, or tethered, unless these devices interfere with the service animal’s work or the individual’s disability prevents him or her from using these devices. Individuals who cannot use such devices must maintain control of the animal through voice, signal, or other effective methods.

evidence.text: British Sign Language Interpreted Events: Where we can, we help facilitate this service when requested at least 8 weeks in advance of an event (subject to availability). If required, we can store your wheelchair on the night; if you would like this, please speak to a steward on the night. Personal wheelchairs will be stored at your own risk. We only have a very limited number of manual wheelchairs available for use in the venue which are available from entrance doors on a first come, first served basis. Please speak to a member of our Security staff on arrival for assistance. Please note that our wheelchairs are for use inside the venue only and cannot be taken to car parks/train station/taxi rank etc. The intended use of the wheelchairs is as a shuttle service to your seat from the entrance door and back again. Unfortunately, we cannot allow customers to keep our wheelchairs for the duration of the event.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Information
evidence.text: The NEC site (including bp pulse LIVE) has designated car park spaces for visitors with disabilities. On arrival at the NEC site, please follow the signage for Arena Disabled Parking. For most Arena events, wider space parking is available next to the Arena in South 1 car park on a first-come, first-served basis (regardless of pre-payment). This car park is a 20–50m walk to/from the Box Office Accessible Entrance. If the Arena disabled parking area is full, customers will be directed to the overspill area in the South car parks (approx. 100–250m walk). Additional parking is available in the East car parks, serviced by free, accessible shuttle buses with a drop-off/pick-up point in front of the Arena Lakeside Accessible entrance (open from doors open time). Payment machines are inside the Arena and just outside the Box Office. We are a cashless venue, so payments are by debit/credit card or mobile phone online. You can find out about how to pre booking your parking on our Parking Page (Allocated parking for blue badge holders may differ for some events – always follow on-site signage.)

evidence.heading: Additional Accommodations
evidence.text: SPAC allows service animals to enter the venue. Service animals are defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) as dogs or miniature horses that are trained to do work to perform tasks related to people with disabilities. The work or task the service animal is trained to do must directly relate to the person’s disability. Service animals must be housebroken. Service animals are required to behave and not repeatedly bark, growl, jump up on, or lunge at other guests or employees. Corrective action must be taken if the service animal is not behaving appropriately.

evidence.heading: Additional Accommodations
evidence.text: Dogs whose sole function is to provide comfort or emotional support do not qualify as service animals under the ADA. Comfort animals, emotional support animals, and therapy dogs are not listed as service animals under Title II and Title III of the ADA. This also applies to the other species of animals, wild or domestic, trained or untrained. The ADA requires the service animal to be under the control of the handler. This may include using a harness, leash, or other tether. Our venue employees are not required to provide for the care or supervision of a service animal, including cleaning up after it. Service animals must remain on the floor and are not allowed on dining chairs or tables in our food and beverage locations. Live Nation and our operating partners have the right to deny access to a service animal that disrupts our operations.

evidence.heading: RE-ENTRY POLICY
evidence.text: Camp Randall Stadium has a no re-entry policy. Once you leave the building during an event, you will not be permitted to return with that ticket. If there is an emergency please contact Guest Services or the nearest usher.

evidence.heading: SMOKING POLICY
evidence.text: University of Wisconsin Athletic facilities, including Camp Randall Stadium, are smoke-free facilities as required by Wisconsin State Law. For the health and comfort of all guests and employees, smoking is prohibited inside all areas of the facilities, including entry gates, concourses, seating areas, restrooms, and all suites and club seats. There are no designated smoking areas at the facilities, nor is exit and re-entry permitted for smoking. This policy also applies to smokeless and electronic cigarettes. Guests who fail to comply with the policy may be subject to ejection from the stadium.

To ensure we can make appropriate arrangements, please submit your request at least two (2) weeks prior to the event. Please contact CHI Health Center Omaha at 402.341.1500 and request the Box Office or fill out our Contact Form and select ‘ADA Compliance’ in the subject dropdown.

They are not guaranteed a seat and may be required to sit on a parent’s lap. Children 3 and over must have a ticket. evidence.heading: Mobile Ticketing
evidence.text: The MLB Ballpark app was upgraded with enhanced security features to protect your mobile tickets. Please update and log in BEFORE you leave for Citizens Bank Park to ensure your tickets and/or parking is ready to scan the moment you arrive. Click “Get Started” Manually enter your password You will then receive a 6-digit one-time code via email, enter that to verify your email address. Next you will be required to enroll your mobile number You will then receive a 6-digit one-time code via text message, enter that to verify your mobile number. Once verified, you will now be logged into the Ballpark app and should be able to access your tickets. After completing these steps, if you are unable to see or access your tickets in the Ballpark app, please call 215-463-1000 or email us at tickets@phillies.com .

Message and data rates may apply.

Please inform our staff of your needs when you arrive at the venue by letting the box office know that you require accessible accommodations, and we will add you to our waitlist. A member of our staff will then meet you to show you your seats.

evidence.heading: If I leave the venue, can I get back in?
evidence.text: If we have to evacuate the venue for severe weather, you'll be allowed to re-enter if/when we're given the all clear. Be sure to have your ticket ready to be re-scanned.

DROP-OFF AND PICK-UP AREAS Find them in front of the North Plaza entrance. Let parking staff know you’re dropping off and they’ll show you the way. When picking up, arrive 45 minutes before the end of the show—you won’t be able to enter otherwise.
For taxis and ride shares, head to our southeast entrance off of Ridgeland Ave.

CONTACTLESS PAYMENTS ONLY We’re a cash-free venue. If you arrive without a debit or credit card, head to our Cash to Card Booth near Gate 4 (in the South Plaza), and they’ll exchange cash for card (for free).

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: Accessible Parking is located just outside of Gate 4 on the southwest side of the venue, in front of the Premier Parking lot. We'd recommend driving into the venue via South Road, through entrance 1. Upon arrival on event day, inform staff that you need accessible parking. Accessible spaces are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. Our parking crew will work to accommodate you if all accessible spaces are full. Fans may also be dropped off near the gates prior to parking. Credit Union 1 Amphitheatre honors any state-issued accessible parking placard for a vehicle that fits in a 9’ x 18’ parking space without impeding the people on either side of your vehicle. Oversized vehicles (e.g. stretch limos, RVs, buses, etc.) with a disabled parking placard will not be allowed to park in an accessible parking space. To ensure you can park as close as possible, we recommend arriving when the parking gates open.

evidence.heading: Service Animals

In connection with our purpose, Cross Insurance Arena is committed to improving the accessibility and usability of its website, www.CrossArenaPortland.com . Cross Insurance Arena has implemented the relevant portions of the World Wide Web Consortium’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0 Level AA (WCAG 2.0 AA) as its web accessibility standard.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Information
evidence.text: Cross Insurance Arena provides ADA seating areas comprised of accessible locations with immediately adjacent companion seating.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Information
evidence.text: There are several viewing areas designed for accessible seating in Sections C, E, G, N, T, V, and X. Floor seating is subject to change depending on the seating configuration for various events. Subject to availability, guests requiring accessible seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the accessible seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the accessible seat will be offered, if available. In the accessible areas, there will be removable, padded folding chairs, so wherever a wheelchair or scooter is needed, the folding chair will be removed.

The third elevator is located at the Cross Insurance Entrance at the corner of Center St. and Spring St.

evidence.heading: Accessible Information
evidence.text: The Cross Insurance Center is one of the most adaptable and accessible entertainment venues in New England. Visiting the Cross Center for an event will not be an inconvenience. Let our professional, friendly staff assist you with any special needs to ensure that your event experience is enjoyable and memorable. The Cross Insurance Center was designed and built to accommodate our guests with special needs by complying with all ADA specifications. Below you will find information and services that we offer to our guests with disabilities and limitations. We encourage all guests who have concerns, comments, or who need assistance to talk to any member of the Cross Insurance Center staff. If any guests have further questions or have suggestions on how to make your experience more enjoyable please call us at 207.561.8300.

evidence.heading: Accessible Information
evidence.text: We offer accessible parking in all parking areas located near the facility. The parking lot, located adjacent to the Renewal by Andersen Entrance of the facility will be the primary parking place for guests with disabilities. All guests who wish to park in the reserved spaces must have a state issued handicapped window pass, sticker, or license plate. Vehicles that do not have these credentials will be allowed to drop guests off at the Hammond Lumber Company Entrance [formerly Southeast Entrance] on Bass Park Blvd. and then proceed to the other parking lots or Hollywood Casino parking garage. There are also two other options for parking which accommodate parking for guests with disabilities – the Raceway Lot located up Bass Park Blvd. on the left and the Buck St. Lot located along the racetrack through the Buck St. entrance.

evidence.heading: Accessible Information
evidence.text: For certain events, such as concerts, Lot J (attached to Renewal by Andersen Entrance) and the Lot O (parallel to Buck St) will be paid parking areas that will allow for free accessible parking up to the total amount of available designated ADA spaces. Once these spaces are full, general parking in these lots will be available as capacity allows for the prevailing charge.

Guests may take their service animal outside of the venue to relieve itself but must speak with a Guest Services Team Member prior to leaving the venue. A guest whose service animal poses a threat to the safety of other Crypto.com Arena guests and staff may be asked to escort the animal off the premises.

Guests may arrange wheelchair assistance by contacting any Guest Services or Event Security team member. In addition, wheelchair assistance can be arranged by calling Guest Services at (801) 325-2198. This hotline is only available to the general public on event days from the time doors open until the conclusion of the event.

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: Bags (including purses) will not be allowed at Delta Center. Diaper bags and medical bags will be allowed if they are no larger than 14”x14”x6”. Clutches will be allowed but must be no larger than 4”x6”x2”. Please note that all medical and diaper bags will be X-rayed upon entrance. Bag X-rays are only located at Door 5 (the main entrance on the North East corner of the arena).

evidence.heading: D
evidence.text: Delta Center and the Utah Jazz participate in the Michelob Ultra Refresh Responsibly Program. This initiative is designed to encourage guests to be responsible designated drivers. Guests who are 21 years of age or older and wish to participate may visit the Michelob Ultra Designated Driver Booth on the main level near Portal X/Door 3 for more information.

evidence.heading: G
evidence.text: Guest Services are located at Door 4/Portal Y on the Main Level and Portal CC on the Terrace Level/Upper Bowl. In addition, each of our Guest Services locations will provide assistance to guests with disabilities. (See: Accessibility Services)

evidence.heading: L
evidence.text: All lost-and-found items are taken to one of our two Guest Services locations. During an event, guests are invited to inquire about lost items at either of the Guest Services locations near Door 4/Portal Y on the Main Level and Portal CC on the Terrace Level/Upper Bowl. After an event, please submit a Lost & Found inquiry form to check if your item has been recovered. All items are held for 30 days, with unclaimed items being donated to charity after that period.

evidence.heading: L
evidence.text: Lost children or guests should be directed to any of our two Guest Services locations at Door 4/Portal Y on the Main Level and Portal CC on the Terrace Level/Upper Bowl or by sending a text to 801-901-8111 or at www.deltacenter.com/feedback . Parents or guardians looking for lost children or members of their party should contact the nearest Guest Services or Event Security team member.

evidence.heading: M
evidence.text: The Utah Jazz and Cozy Earth are dedicated to creating spaces that prioritize both the comfort and safety for families visiting Delta Center. Designed to meet the growing needs of mothers and infants attending Utah Jazz games, Utah Mammoth games, concerts, and other public events at Delta Center, the six Cozy Earth Mother’s Rooms are located on the main concourse near door 1 and door 7 and on level 5 next to the Sensory Room. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, featuring newly upgraded seating areas, TVs, sinks, and full-length mirrors, as well as Cozy Earth products that elevate the space and provide mothers with a world-class experience.

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: Box Office The Desert Diamond Arena Box Office is located on the northeast corner of the venue between Gate 4 and Gate 5. Note that Gate 4 is considered the main entry gate for the venue. On event days, the Box Office opens three (3) hours prior to showtime and will typically remain open until the main act takes the stage, though this is subject to change. For Arizona Rattlers games, the Box Office will remain open through the end of the third (3rd) quarter. Acceptable forms of payment at the Box Office include all major credit and debit cards plus digital wallets, e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc. The Box Office is closed on non-event days; however, anyone looking to make a ticket purchase can do so online via ticketmaster.com or AXS.com .

evidence.heading: E
evidence.text: Entry Screening For the safety of all guests, vendors, and employees, anyone entering Desert Diamond Arena will be subject to a security screening and bag inspection by venue security personnel. Security screening can vary by entrance and may include an electronic screening, a metal detector screening, and/or a handheld wand screening. Guests with implanted medical devices or other safety concerns can request an alternative screening with Desert Diamond Arena security staff who will be happy to assist.

evidence.heading: 50/50 Raffle
evidence.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers Foundation (LADF) 50/50 Raffle is back for the 2026 season! From the time the gates open until the end of the seventh inning, fans may purchase raffle tickets from uniformed ticket sellers wearing pink 50/50 raffle aprons and stationary kiosks located throughout the concourses at the stadium. Here is your chance to win big, in the name of charity! Every game, 50% of the jackpot is awarded to one lucky winner and the remaining 50% supports LADF's programs and grantmaking to local nonprofit organizations. Purchase a 50/50 raffle ticket and support LADF!

evidence.heading: Alcohol
evidence.text: Alcohol is served from the time the stadium gates open to the public through the 7th inning. Alcohol is limited to a maximum of 2 alcoholic beverages per person per purchase. Alcohol may not be purchased by persons under the age of 21, according to California law. Proper identification with proof of age must be presented at time of sale. Alcohol sales may be discontinued at any time.

evidence.heading: Buses/Limos/TCP/Oversized Vehicles

Recommended entrance for oversized vehicles is through Sunset Gate A on Vin Scully Ave. Oversized vehicle parking is $65 per vehicle in advance, and $70 at the gate. Prices may vary.

evidence.heading: Gate Times

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: General Parking : General parking passes cost $40 per vehicle for automobiles and motorcycles. For those that do not purchase in advance, parking will cost $45 once parking gates open (approximately 2.5 hours to game time). Gates will not accommodate Cash parking.

evidence.heading: UNIQLO Field at Dodger Stadium Policies & Information
evidence.text: Screenshots of tickets are not considered valid tickets and will not scan at the gates. You must present a valid mobile ticket (and not a screenshot) to be permitted entry into the stadium.

evidence.heading: Ballpark app
evidence.text: How to Enter a Dodger game at the stadium Simply have the Ballpark app open and pull up your ticket barcode for that day's game. If you're entering with a group, you have the option to scan multiple tickets on one device, use Go-Ahead Entry facial authentication technology at select gates, or forward tickets to your group in advance to be scanned via the Ballpark app on their devices. Having issues scanning in? Be sure to adjust your screen's brightness and watch out for glares from lights or the sun, both of which may prevent your mobile ticket from scanning properly. Making your way to your seats at the stadium? Simply show your Guest Service Representative your mobile ticket on the Ballpark app to be directed to your seat. Note: If you have both the Ballpark app as well as a printed ticket for the same seat, the first ticket scanned is the only one that will allow entry into the stadium. Once a ticket has been scanned, it cannot be forwarded.

evidence.heading: Ballpark app
evidence.text: How to Forward Tickets You can easily forward tickets via the Ballpark app by tapping the "Share" icon. Mobile tickets can be forwarded via email or a text link. When you forward a ticket, it will still appear on your list of tickets in the Ballpark app, but it will not feature a mobile barcode. Mobile tickets without barcodes cannot be used for entry into the stadium. You may choose to cancel a forwarded ticket and have it reinstated as a live mobile ticket in your Ballpark app. Instructions on how to cancel a forwarded ticket are provided on a later page.

evidence.heading: Ballpark app
evidence.text: EMAIL: To forward a single ticket via email, select that recipient's name from your device's address book or enter their email address directly. The recipient will be sent an email notifying them that you have sent mobile ticket(s). The recipient must click "Access Tickets" in that email in order to receive the ticket(s).

evidence.heading: Ballpark app
evidence.text: TEXT: If you do not know a recipient's email address, you can share a ticket via text message by selecting the "Forward via Link" option. Simply select that recipient from your address book or enter their mobile phone number. They will receive a text with a link to accept that mobile ticket.

evidence.text: Dos Equis Pavilion is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible experience for all fans. Below is information about available accessibility services and how to request accommodations.
Dos Equis Pavilion Accessibility Services

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: Accessible parking is available at Dos Equis Pavilion. To park in an accessible parking space, you will need a valid, state-issued accessible placard or license plate and a venue parking pass. Parking passes can be purchased online via Ticketmaster in advance or on the day of the show with a credit card when you arrive at the parking lots. General parking will be $20 per vehicle (plus tax) online in advance and $25 on the event day. To use an accessible space, your vehicle must display a valid, state-issued accessible placard or license plate, and the person to whom the placard or plate is issued must be in the vehicle. Accessible parking areas are actively monitored, and credentials may be subject to inspection to prevent misuse. All applicable state and local laws apply. Misuse of an accessible space may result in citation, fines, or relocation.

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: Accessible spaces are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. Our parking crew will work to accommodate you if all accessible spaces are full. Fans may also be dropped off near the gates prior to parking. Dos Equis Pavilion has parking available on the East and West side of the venue, located off of South Fitzhugh Avenue. Turn on your emergency flashers to help parking staff identify your needs and they will direct you to the appropriate area. Guests in need of accessible parking should enter the following gates and check in with the parking attendant on where to park:

evidence.heading: Accessible Ticketing
evidence.text: Accessible tickets can only be purchased online at dosequispavilion.com/shows . Our box office is not able to take ticket orders over the phone, and our website is the only method to purchase tickets. Accessible tickets are reserved solely for fans with disabilities and their companions. Fans who abuse this policy could have their order canceled.

evidence.heading: Accessible Ticketing
evidence.text: To find tickets in the Accessible Seating Area of Dos Equis Pavilion, select the Filters icon on the upper right of the page where you see available tickets. For a reserved seated show, you will be shown your seat location once the ticket is selected. More information regarding the purchase of accessible seating on Ticketmaster can be found here . In a general admission event, the accessible seating area can reach capacity early and is first-come, first-served. Our Accessible section on the floor is located at the main walkway into the House, at the East and West side entrances. Upon entry, there will be an open area beside the rail that is available to Accessibility. If a chair is needed, guests can inquire with security in the area. Security will be on standby for the Accessibility section for the duration of the event.

evidence.heading: Accessible Ticketing
evidence.text: Our accessible section of the lawn, located at the bottom of the lawn on the East and West corners, has reserved seating, in addition to a general admission area that is first-come, first-served. The lawn is uncovered and subjected to the elements. In inclement weather, the terrain can become difficult to navigate. Note: The Starplex Lawn Deck seats are accessible via staircase in the West Plaza only. There is a concrete ramp that goes halfway up the lawn, towards The Starplex Lawn Deck.

evidence.heading: Accessible Ticketing

evidence.text: Our lawn is uncovered and subjected to the elements. Our accessible lawn area includes a designated pathway and entrance that is designed to accommodate people in wheelchairs and those with mobility aids.

For more questions, or information not mentioned below, don't hesitate to get in touch with us at 214.421.1111 . The Box Office is only open on show days and will be open starting at 12PM every show day.

evidence.text: Assistive Listening Devices are available for all events. To request a device, please visit the Box Office prior to entry or the Guest Services booth located in the East Plaza if inside the venue. A valid ID may be required and availability is limited. Assistive Listening Devices (ALDs) technology at Dos Equis Pavilion are powered by Listen Everywhere Technology™. This allows you to use your mobile device and headphones as your personal ALD. If you do not wish to use your device, please see Guest Services to get a receiver. A photo ID is required to be held until the device is returned at the end of the event.

evidence.heading: Effective Communication Accommodations

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: EagleBank Arena welcomes disabled guests who need the use of a dog as a service animal when the dog has been individually trained or is in training to do work or perform tasks for the guest. Comfort animals are not allowed in EagleBank Arena . Guests using a service animal will be responsible for the animal’s care and supervision when present at EagleBank Arena. We recommend that the Office of Accessible Seating and Services be contacted to purchase accessible seating or be notified prior to the event if special accommodations are needed for service animals. Please see the Accessible Seating/ADA page for more information.

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: EagleBank Arena endeavors to provide an effective means of communication for guests with hearing and/or vision impairments. American Sign Language interpretation will be provided when requested. To ensure that EagleBank Arena provides a qualified sign language interpreter, all requests for this service must be received 14 days in advance of the event date. This lead time is required to coordinate requests with the promoter/artist and the local interpreting agencies. All requests for sign interpretation should be directed to the Accessible Seating line at 703-993-3035, or by emailing Lindsey Park (lbross@gmu.edu). An assistive listening system for our hearing impaired guests is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Headsets are available at the event in our Guest Services office.

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: Ticketed guests needing a wheelchair or special escort to their seats can request an escort upon arrival by speaking with any team member. For further information regarding our accessible seating services visit the Accessible Seating/ADA page.

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: The Box Office is located at the West Entrance. Please visit our Box Office page for more information and hours.

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: A general admission ticket to an EagleBank Arena event means there are no reserved seats and, in the case of a floor general admission ticket, there are no seats, only standing. Typically, doors will open one and one-half hours (90 minutes) prior to the event starting time for events with general admission tickets. Patrons with general admission floor tickets should assemble and enter at the North entrance. Entry of patrons is controlled and there is no running to seats or crowding at the doors. There are no chairs on the floor for general admission events; the floor is standing room only. For a concert where the floor is general admission, the permanent seats in the arena are usually RESERVED seats. On each general admission ticket there are numbers printed for “seat” and “row,” but these numbers are for ticketing inventory purposes only, and do not correspond to a location inside the building.

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide
evidence.text: For George Mason Basketball games, the pass gate or press entrance for the media is located at the West entrance, to the left of the box office when you are facing the building. Press requests for concerts and other events are handled strictly by the event, not EagleBank Arena.

evidence.heading: P
evidence.text: Pass Through the Land Located within the Platte River Park on the east side of the stadium, “Pass Through the Land” consists of massive, flat-top boulders placed in concentric rings within an Aspen Grove representing the mesas and plateaus of Colorado. At the entrance to the grove are five 28’ high towers with metal mesh and trembling disks that catch the light and create wind chimes. On game day, thousands of fans coming from the light rail and parking areas east of I-25 walk through “Pass Through the Land”, enjoying the area as a location to picnic, people watch, or simply to take in the game-day environment.

Pregame Drop-Off / Postgame Pick-Up Procedure DROP-OFF: West side drop-off: Located near Gate 1. Enter Lot M using the Georgia and Adams Street entrance. Please note that vehicles parked or idling in designated lots without a valid pass will be towed at the owner's expense. PICK UP: Traffic continues to flow away from the stadium for at least 30-45 minutes following the game. Please direct guest(s) needing assistance to either use the postgame golf cart shuttle service or wait at the closest gate location until the traffic pattern is no longer one-way.

evidence.text: WHEELCHAIR ESCORT Wheelchair escort service is available at all perimeter gates of the stadium. Please find a Mobility Assistance Representative at most gate entries to request an escort when you arrive. This service will bring guests from the perimeter gate to their seats. Wheelchair escort service will return after the game to pick up guests at their seats and return them to their original perimeter entry gate. Due to high demand, please note the service may come with a wait time. Please note that if you need a wheelchair for all movements throughout the stadium, it is advised that you bring a wheelchair for your personal use throughout the entire day and contact the Jaguars ticket office at (904) 633-2000 for accessible seating availability. The Jaguars do not offer storage for personal wheelchairs or other accessibility devices in-stadium. The wheelchair escort service is intended to relieve patrons in need of the initial long entry and exit walks.

evidence.text: FedExForum is located in downtown Memphis at the heart of the city’s Beale Street Entertainment District. evidence.heading: Cashless Food & Beverage

evidence.heading: Is Festhalle barrier-free?
evidence.text: The 1st and 2nd balconies of the Festhalle are not barrier-free, as there is no elevator access. A corresponding ticket must be purchased in advance—please contact the ticket provider early to make arrangements. An accompanying person does not need a separate ticket and may sit with you in the designated area.

evidence.heading: Frankfurt's low-emission zone
evidence.text: Vehicles without emission stickers are exempt in driving to Messe Frankfurt (Frankfurt Fair & Exhibition Centre). They are permitted to drive to the fairground's "West" or "Nord" gates and enter there. These gates may be reached from the A5 motorway, either via the A648 regional road, exiting at "Rebstock", or the "Katharinenkreisel" roundabout. Messe Frankfurt's multi-storey car park ("Rebstock") is also directly accessible from the "Rebstock" exit. You are only permitted to drive in the low-emission zone (areas marked in red) if your vehicle displays an emissions sticker.

evidence.heading: Transferring Tickets
evidence.text: Easily transfer tickets to each member of your party. Either before entering the gates or once inside, it is a good idea to transfer a ticket to each member of your group before entering the seating area. Transferring your tickets will allow everyone to re-enter the seating area even if your group splits up. allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) with no obscured interior pockets up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Bags and wallets exceeding the size of a small clutch bag (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
Any bag larger than the permissible size (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

Some activities will end prior to first pitch, inflatables and the Play Ball field will remain open through the end of the 7th inning, and the Nuna playground will be open all game!

There are (4) four Lock & Go Lockers located around Petco Park - Lexus Premier Lot across the Home Plate Gate entrance, Tony Gwynn Dr. and L Street, Balboa Gate and East Village Gate.

evidence.heading: T
evidence.text: The San Diego Padres offer a variety of Theme Games to enhance the fan experience at Petco Park! Theme Game tickets include access to a limited-edition item or experience and are separate from Padres Giveaways that are distributed to fans upon entrance to the ballpark. To participate in a Theme Game, fans must purchase the specific Theme Game ticket package. Theme Game tickets can be purchased online at Padres.com/ThemeGames , over the phone by calling 619.795.5555 or at the Petco Park Box Office.

evidence.heading: T
evidence.text: Please Note: Theme Game items are only available with the purchase of a Theme Game ticket package and cannot be combined with any other offers, promotions, or discounts. Items must be redeemed on the day of the event from the Theme Game redemption area. Unless otherwise noted, redemption is from the time gates open until 1 hour after first pitch. Visit Padres.com/ThemeGames to learn more and purchase tickets!

evidence.heading: E
evidence.text: Re-entry is permitted at Petco Park. Guests will need to get their digital ticket scanned before exiting and scan back in for re-entry. On select giveaway days, our re-entry policy will not be applicable until all promotional items have been exhausted or until the completion of the 3 rd inning. Re-entry is prohibited once the game or event has concluded.

evidence.heading: S

evidence.heading: G
evidence.text: Complimentary shuttle service is available for guests with disabilities. The shuttles provide transportation between the Padres Parkade, Tailgate Park, the MTS Garage and Petco Park. The shuttle service is available two (2) hours prior to the start of a scheduled game and continues for approximately one-half (1/2) hour following the conclusion of the game. Guests upon arrival may also text "requesting a shuttle and location" to 619.279.5881. Guests wishing to utilize this service following the game should report to the Park Boulevard and Imperial Avenue as a designated shuttle pickup.

evidence.heading: L

evidence.heading: L

evidence.heading: L

evidence.text: Did you know? The GIANT Center is a 10,500-seat multi-purpose arena in Hershey, Pennsylvania and home to the Hershey Bears ® ice hockey club. On September 3, 2002 it was announced that Cher would be the first act to perform in GIANT Center , with her "Living Proof - The Farewell Tour." Hershey Sports is located on the main concourse at the front entrance to GIANT Center . GIANT Center also features 4 other merchandise locations which are open during Hershey Bears home games and various GIANT Center events. Hershey Sports is temporarily CLOSED until further notice. When you arrive, inform the cashier that you require close parking and they will do their best to accommodate you, subject to availability.

evidence.heading: ACCESSIBLE ACCESS
evidence.text: Accessible Parking/Drop-Off: The accessible pickup/drop-off zone is located on Joe Nuxhall Way, between Mehring Way and Freedom Way, along the west side of Great American Ball Park. There is a second accessible pick/drop off zone located at the corner of Broadway and Mehring Way on the Southeast corner of the ballpark. Cars, vans and small buses displaying a valid accessible placard or valid accessible license plate will be permitted to enter the pickup/drop-off zone beginning one half (1/2) hour before gates open to approximately one (1) hour after the conclusion of the game. Large school buses and large charter/tour buses are prohibited from entering this zone. Guests traveling to the ballpark in a large school bus or large charter/tour bus should contact the Group Sales department at (513) 765-7600 for information on bus pickup and drop-off locations.

evidence.heading: FAN ACCOMMODATION STATIONS (TRIHEALTH FAN ACCOMMODATION STATIONS)
evidence.text: Guest-relations personnel will be on hand to assist guests with any questions, comments or concerns. You can also pick up any certificate and Anti-Lost Wristbands for children at either TriHealth Fan Accommodations Station.

evidence.heading: LOST CHILDREN/MISSING PERSONS
evidence.text: Guests should report a missing person to any Ballpark staff member, law enforcement officer or at a TriHealth Fan Accommodation Station immediately. Subsequently, efforts will be taken, working closely with law enforcement and security, to locate and reunite the missing person. To assist with missing children, parents can stop at the Terrace Level TriHealth Fan Accommodation location to pick up a wristband for their child to wear during their visit. Parents can fill in their name, their child’s name, and their phone number to assist Reds staff in the reunification process.

evidence.heading: Box Office Information
evidence.text: The main box-office is located on the plaza level (4th floor of Heritage Bank Center facing Great American Ballpark). You may access the plaza level by utilizing the steps surrounding Heritage Bank Center and Great American Ballpark or by entering the security entrance (corner of Mehring Way and Old Broadway) on non-event days.

evidence.heading: Sensory Kits
evidence.text: Heritage Bank Center offers sensory kits that you may check-out for patrons that are sensitive to auditory and visual stimulation. Kits include antiglare glasses, communication card, identification wristbands, noise-reducing ear covers, small "fidget" toy, sanitizing wipes & tissues, venue map & more. Please stop by the customer service desk (next to the main entrance) for more information.

evidence.heading: Age Restrictions
evidence.text: Children two and older must have a valid ticket to gain entrance to the venue. Age restrictions vary per event.

evidence.heading: Dress Code
evidence.text: Guests are prohibited from wearing any clothing displaying profane or offensive material. Guests found within the venue wearing clothing displaying items that can be construed as profane or offensive by management will be asked to provide a solution where the items will no longer be displayed. If no solution can be found, or the solutions do not meet the satisfaction of management, the guest may be ejected from the facility. Additionally, all guests must be fully-clothed to enter any area of the venue. Guests without shirts, shoes, etc. will not be permitted entrance.

evidence.heading: Merchandise
evidence.text: The Main Merchandise stand is located inside the Main Entrance by Section 104. For larger shows, auxiliary stands are often set up behind sections 117, 126, and 138.

evidence.heading: VIP ENTRANCE
evidence.text: Beginning for the Friday, March 4 performance, Heritage Bank Center premium seat and suite holders will now have their own exclusive entrance into the facility. Located on the Northeast corner of the venue, the VIP Entrance will allow expedited entry. Doors will open at the same time as regular admittance for contemporary events but you will now be able to enter 15 minutes early for Cyclones games. As you will only have access to this entrance, your tickets will still be accepted at all other gates into Heritage Bank Center as well. Also, please be sure to make note and make your clients, employees, and friends aware of the bag policy that was instituted in October 2021.

evidence.heading: VIP ENTRANCE
evidence.text: Please understand that we will be monitoring the new VIP Entrance and ensuring that we can provide the most efficient entry that you have ever experienced at Heritage Bank Center. There are many moving parts within this new venture, so please be patient with our staff. Beginning with your April monthly tickets that will be sent later this month, we will identify your VIP access with an exclusive identifying ticket stock that will allow for seamless entry. We will keep you up to speed with that application. For now, please enjoy your new amenity as your tickets have been coded for entry beginning with Friday’s Katt Williams’ performance! Thank you for your patience and support as we attempt to enhance your VIP Experience at Heritage Bank Center!

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: General parking is located in the field parking areas across Hersheypark Drive. The entrance to the field parking area is located at the intersection of Boathouse Rd. and PA39 (Hershey Rd.). Guests using the field parking areas should follow posted walkway signage and the directions of parking staff to cross Hersheypark Drive to reach Hersheypark Stadium .

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: Designated ADA parking for concerts at Hersheypark Stadium is first come, first serve in the paved Hersheypark lots on the West Side of the Stadium and the upper lot. All guests with ADA plates/placards should follow the signs located on Hersheypark Drive to the main Hersheypark Entertainment Complex entrance, pass through the parking booths and then continue past GIANT Center to access the designated ADA lots next to the Stadium.

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: Guests with mobility challenges should enter via the Hersheypark Entertainment Complex main entrance on Park Blvd. and then follow the instructions of the parking staff. Guests with mobility issues can also be dropped off at Hershey’s Chocolate World or in the ADA parking area by the Northwest side of the Stadium.

evidence.heading: Where should I park?
evidence.text: General parking is located in the field parking areas across Hersheypark Drive. The entrance to the field parking area is located at the intersection of Boathouse Rd. and PA39 (Hershey Rd.). evidence.heading: What time do doors open?

evidence.heading: Facts
evidence.text: Did you know? The GIANT Center is a 10,500-seat multi-purpose arena in Hershey, Pennsylvania and home to the Hershey Bears ® ice hockey club. Hershey Bears have held the AHL record for attendance since 2006. On September 3, 2002 it was announced that Cher would be the first act to perform in GIANT Center , with her "Living Proof - The Farewell Tour." The GIANT Center was designed by HOK Sport + Venue + Event out of Kansas City. Merchandise Visit Hershey Sports, the official store for Hershey Bears merchandise and apparel. Hershey Sports is located on the main concourse at the front entrance to GIANT Center . GIANT Center also features 4 other merchandise locations which are open during Hershey Bears home games and various GIANT Center events. Hershey Sports is temporarily CLOSED until further notice. evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: Main entrance doors to the arena typically open 60-90 minutes prior to event start time.

evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: General Admission ticket holders can arrive at Honda Center to obtain sequentially numbered wristbands beginning at 10:00am the day of show at the East Entrance. Any guest arriving earlier than 10:00am will be asked to leave and return at 10:00am. The parking lot will open at 9:45am. Wristbands will be distributed until 3:30pm sharp.

evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: Once guests receive their numbered wristband, they may leave the premises, but they must return to their sequential place in line at the East Entrance by 4:00pm. This time will be strictly enforced, guests are asked to plan accordingly.

evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: If a numbered wristbanded guest arrives after 4:00pm, the number on their wristband is void, and they will take their place at the end of the GA line. Each guest must be in possession of a general admission ticket to obtain a wristband - only one wristband per guest will be distributed. Guests cannot reserve/pick-up wristbands for other guests. GA numbered wristbands are non-transferable. Loss, removal or tampering of the GA wristband will result in loss of place in the GA line. Regardless of arrival time, guests who have a GA ticket must enter through the East Entrance to obtain a floor access wristband. Please note that VIP ticket holders may receive priority entry. VIP ticket holders will line up at the East Entrance.

evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: Seating and hospitality options are expanding as well. New opera box suites will be added on the Plaza Level, all existing luxury suites will be renovated, and new hospitality amenities will be introduced across the Plaza and Upper Levels. A five-story addition on the south side of the arena will bring escalators for easier access, a new Anaheim Ducks Team Store, a Columbia Bank Club Level restaurant, and a completely transformed South Entrance experience.

evidence.heading: Access Guide for Guests with Disabilities
evidence.text: The Kansas City Royals and our staff would like to welcome you to Kauffman Stadium! We take pride in our ballpark being accessible for everyone and ensuring our guests with disabilities have an enjoyable and comfortable experience. We are always looking for ways to improve our ballpark experience and the quality of each guest's visit, so your feedback and suggestions are vital to our success.

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: More than 500 reserved parking spaces are available to properly licensed or tagged vehicles for guests with disabilities. Spaces are available in all parking lots except Lot L and Lot N. A limited number of van-accessible spaces are available in each of these lots. Wheelchair ramps are present in all parking lots. The reserved spots are filled on a first-come, first-served basis. Guests with disabilities, or those persons transporting a guest with a disability, should notify Royals personnel of their desire to park in an accessible space. Those without the proper license tag or permit to park in a reserved space, but have someone who has trouble walking, should be directed to the nearest non- accessible parking space.

evidence.heading: Concessions
evidence.text: All concession stands are accessible and guests are encouraged to speak with the nearest Royals associate for additional assistance.

evidence.heading: Drop-off/Pick Up Areas
evidence.text: Fans with disabilities may be dropped off at two accessible entries into the stadium-Gates B and D. Guest Ambassadors may meet guests with disabilities at one of these areas to assist them to their seats should they request assistance. Guests who wish to use this service should tell all traffic personnel that they would like to drop off a guest with a disability at one of the above-listed areas. After dropping off the person, the driver should then park the vehicle as directed.

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: The guest assistance shuttles will operate for each of the Royals 81 home games, shuttling guests with disabilities or needing physical assistance from the Truman Sports Complex parking lots to the Kauffman Stadium gates. Prior to and during the game, Guest Ambassadors provide shuttle service for guests from the parking lots. Please let your nearest parking attendant know if you are in need of golf cart assistance or guests may call the Game-day Assistance Phone Line ( 816-504-4040 , option #5) once parked. After the event, cart shuttles pick up guests requiring assistance at all Gates (A, B, C, D, and E). All cart shuttles will drop off on the perimeter of the parking lots.

evidence.heading: Guest Services
evidence.text: Our Guest Ambassadors assist guests with special needs and disabilities to ensure a comfortable experience on game days. Prior to and during the game, Guest Ambassadors provide shuttle service for guests from the parking lots to the stadium gates. Guests may call the Game Day Assistance Phone Line (816-504-4040, option #5) once parked or let the closest parking lot attendant know they are in need of a shuttle. Guest Ambassadors also provide wheelchair service inside each gate to assist guests to their seats. After the event, golf cart shuttles pick up guests requiring assistance from all Gates (A, B, C, D, and E) to the parking lots. All cart shuttles drop off on the perimeter of the parking lots after the game. For more information or assistance, guests can contact the Guest Experience Department at guestservice@royals.com or 816-504-4204. Guests may also visit Guest Services on Plaza Level or View Level behind home plate for any other assistance.

evidence.heading: Public Transportation
evidence.text: Cabs and rideshare services (Uber, Lyft, etc.) pick up in the middle of Parking Lot A after each game. Guests can visit Guest Services if needing a telephone to call a cab.

evidence.text: The guest assistance shuttles will operate for each of the Royals 81 home games, shuttling guests with disabilities or needing physical assistance from the Truman Sports Complex parking lots to the Kauffman Stadium gates. Please let your nearest parking attendant know if you are in need of golf cart assistance or guests may call the Game-day Assistance Phone Line (816-504-4040, option #5) once parked or 816-504-4201, or 816-504-4444. Please provide parking lot location (A4, G23, etc,) make/model/color of car. How many passengers require a ride. After the event, cart shuttles pick up guests requiring assistance from Price Chopper Price Chopper Gate B and Blue KC Gate D. If a guest needs picked up at Gates A, C, or E, please find the nearest associate and they can call for a cart for pick up. All cart shuttles will drop off on the perimeter of the parking lots. evidence.text: Rideshare services like Uber, Lyft, and Taxi Service are available at Kauffman Stadium. West Side: Enter through Toll Gate 5, drop off in front of Price Chopper Gate B (third base), exit to the west side at Gate 7. Post-Game: Enter through Gate 1 and look for the designated Traffic Row in the middle of Lot A.

evidence.heading: Exploring Kansas City
evidence.text: While you’re in town, you can experience all the delicious local food, unforgettable festivities, and fierce fandom right here at The K. Head out to the Outfield Experience for great barbecue, activities for the kids, and a close-up view of our iconic fountains. Snap a pic at the stunning photo ops scattered around the stadium and stop by our official Royals Team Store to pick up some gear.

evidence.heading: LANXESS arena
evidence.text: Das Backstage Restaurant bietet bis zu 600 Sitzplätze und befindet sich im Norden der LANXESS arena auf Höhe der beiden Logenebenen, wodurch die Gäste bei Veranstaltungen mit offener Bühne direkt in den beeindruckenden Innenraum der Arena blicken können. Im Restaurant stellen wir unseren Gästen ein reichhaltiges Buffet mit einer großen Auswahl an Speisen und Getränken zur Verfügung. Der Besuch wird in der Regel im Vorfeld des Events in Kombination mit der entsprechenden Ticketkategorie gebucht. Sollten am Veranstaltungstag weitere Gäste das Backstage Restaurant besuchen wollen, können diese gerne am Buffet teilnehmen – die Preise hierzu variieren je nach Veranstaltung. À la carte Service wird im Backstage Restaurant nicht angeboten, externe Gäste können aber gerne in gemütlicher Atmosphäre ein Getränk an der Bar verzehren. Für gewöhnlich ist das Backstage Restaurant von Einlass- bis zum Veranstaltungsbeginn geöffnet. Bei Sportveranstaltungen – darunter selbstverständlich alle Heimspiele der Kölner Haie – oder Events, bei denen es die Bühnenkonstruktion zulässt, ist das Backstage Restaurant auch während der gesamten Veranstaltungsdauer geöffnet.

Because there are no dedicated driving lanes, the carts circulate around the outer perimeter of the main stadium lots and will drop off/pickup guests to/from the nearest gate entrance.

evidence.heading: Pre-Kickoff Exit & Re-Entry Policy
evidence.text: 6 p.m. or later start times, the Atrium is open to ticketed guests six hours prior to kickoff. To access the Atrium before the stadium seating areas open (two hours prior to kickoff), please enter at the American Family Insurance Gate on the east side of the stadium, where your ticket will be scanned. You may exit the Atrium and re-enter later by having your ticket "exit scanned" at the American Family Insurance Gate no later than four hours prior to kickoff. Once properly "exit scanned", your ticket will be valid for re-entry for the game. Please be aware that once your ticket has been "scanned in", if you choose to leave the stadium at any time without having your ticket properly "exit scanned" during the limited time frame of six to four hours prior to kickoff, you will not be allowed re-entry.

evidence.heading: Persons under 18 years of age
evidence.text: Events hosted by PROGRESJA are open for all people over 12 years old (with exception of those dedicated especially for kids and teens). Minors may enter the club with a written consent of their legal guardian ( FORM ), unless the club states otherwise at a specific event. Information regarding parental consent for a minor to attend a concert organized by Progresja is necessary for us to ensure the safety of event participants. We require that the child have a completed and signed consent form by their legal guardian, using the form available on our website, and we verify this during ticket inspection at the entrance to the concert. However, we DO NOT COLLECT, STORE, or PROCESS these forms or the personal data contained therein. We only want to ensure that the minor is participating in the event with the consent of their guardian, and we can contact them if necessary.This information applies to concerts organized by Progresja. In the case of events organized by other organizers, they may have separate policies in this regard.

We are actively working to increase the accessibility and usability of our website and in doing so we strive to adhere to the following standards and guidelines:

evidence.heading: Website
evidence.text: This website conforms to the Double-A level of the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 1.0 . These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities, as well as people without disabilities in certain situations, such as people using a slow Internet connection, people with "temporary disabilities" such as a broken arm, and people with changing abilities due to aging. Conformance with these guidelines will help make the web more user friendly for all people.

evidence.heading: Fan Credo Expectations
evidence.text: Accessible (ADA) Seating and Parking

evidence.heading: Accessible (ADA) Seating and Parking
evidence.text: Accessible (ADA) seating is available throughout the stadium on all levels. Guests who require ADA seating, including PSL Owners, should contact the Ticket Office at 410-261-RAVE (7283) to purchase those seats in advance. Seats are offered on a first-come, first-serve basis and ADA seating may not be available on game day. ADA parking is located in Lots B/C and Lot R (located off of the Russell Street Service Drive). ADA parking cannot be purchased in advance and is first come, first-serve. Access to disabled parking spaces is limited to vehicles with state-issued disabled license plates or valid disabled hangtags. In addition, the person to whom the disabled tag was issued must be in the vehicle and will be asked to provide a state MVA disabled registration card, state-issued identification and a valid game ticket. Parking lots will open 4 and a half hours prior to kickoff and tailgating is prohibited. Kits for guests with sensory disabilities are available at stadium guest services locations.

evidence.heading: Multipurpose Rooms & Nursing Mothers
evidence.text: Our Multipurpose Guest Service locations can be used for nursing mothers and/or guests with disabilities who might need to escape the elements during the game. These spaces are stocked with sensory items such as headphones, toys, etc., allowing a comfortable, quiet, private area for those that need it.

evidence.heading: Restrooms
evidence.text: There are 46 restrooms on the upper and lower concourses and 28 on Club Level. Changing stations are available in all restrooms. All restrooms are accessible to fans with disabilities. Family Restroom Locations are listed below.

evidence.heading: Service Animal Policy
evidence.text: Only Service Dogs are permitted within M&T Bank Stadium, in accordance with ADA guidelines.

evidence.heading: Xfinity FlockYard
evidence.text: Located next to the Under Armour Landing and NE Flock Shop (inside North Plaza), Xfinity FlockYard is exclusive to guests who purchased hospitality packages for the space. It opens 1 hour prior to gates opening, and pre-game catering breaks down 30 minutes prior to kickoff. Throughout the game, it remains accessible to guests who have cloth wristbands that specify "Xfinity FlockYard Lofts," up until when North Plaza closes (up to 90 minutes post-game, subject to change game to game).

evidence.heading: Admission Policy
evidence.text: All gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff. Parking lots will open 4.5 hours prior to kickoff. Due to heightened security measures at the gates, we strongly urge all guests to arrive at the stadium as early as possible to avoid entrance delays, particularly in colder weather. Re-entry into M&T Bank Stadium is not permitted.

evidence.heading: Admission Policy
evidence.text: If medical items are required (e.g. diaper bags, medical bags, medications, etc.), be sure to have them with you upon entry. Please go through the Family Medical Lanes located at all four main gates: MedStar Health Gate A, Gate B, Gate C, and Southwest Gate D.

evidence.heading: Bicycle Parking
evidence.text: A designated bicycle parking area at M&T Bank Stadium is conveniently located behind the Bud Light Bash tents by Southwest Gate D. evidence.heading: Ravens Revamp Flock Friendly Fare at M&T Bank Stadium
evidence.text: With the goal of keeping Ravens gamedays an affordable experience, the value menu delivers both quality and budget-friendly options for guests attending M&T Bank Stadium. Compared to the initial launch in 2018, many items are priced lower, and new offerings from Hospitality Evermore include Blackbird Chips and a BBQ Chicken Sandwich, along with an upgraded premium all-beef hot dog. The Flock Friendly Fare menu will also be widely offered on all levels of the stadium, making concessions visits more convenient and easily accessible for fans on gamedays. evidence.heading: Accessibility Services
evidence.text: Mercedes-Benz Stadium offers wheelchair and companion seating with enhanced sight lines throughout every level of the stadium. For most events, accessible seating options can be purchased directly through Ticketmaster.com by toggling the “show accessible tickets” button under the filter tool. A person with a disability, or a third party purchasing on their behalf, can buy as many tickets as allowed within the event ticket limit. Tickets for accessible seats may be sold to individuals who require accessible seating themselves or to someone purchasing on their behalf. Individuals who do not fall within the categories above but prefer accessible seating are not permitted to purchase these seats.

evidence.heading: Wheelchair Escorts
evidence.text: Complimentary wheelchair escorts can be arranged by calling our Guest Experience Department or stopping by a Guest Information Booth during the event. For an escort during an event at Moda Center, please call 503-797-9750 ; for events at Veteran’s Memorial Coliseum, please call (503)-797-9650 . Our Guest Experience Attendants can escort you to your seat from anywhere on the Rose Quarter campus. After the event, our attendants can escort you back to your vehicle or pick-up location on the campus. Please note, both Information Booth phone lines will only be answered thirty minutes before DOORS open on event days.

evidence.heading: Bars & Restaurants
evidence.text: Inspired by one of the most respected coaches in NBA history, Dr. “Jack” Ramsay, who flawlessly led the Trail Blazers to the 1977 title, Dr. Jack’s is a tribute to this esteemed Hall of Famer. Located just outside the Moda Center’s Southwest entrance, Dr. Jack’s is the perfect destination spot pre and post-game. Featuring locally sourced ingredients and fresh flavors any true Portland foodie can appreciate, the menu offers unique, fan-favorite fare with a twist! Enjoy a refreshing signature cocktail or sip on a variety of local craft beers and wines inside with all the action, or relax on our outdoor patios. Whether you’re enjoying a game with friends and family or entertaining clients, Dr. Jack’s is sure to please any crowd! Dr. Jack's hours can be found on your upcoming event's page.

evidence.text: Accessible Parking Mohegan Arena at Casey Plaza provides parking for guests with accessible needs near the East Gate Entrance (Main Entrance) and guests with VIP Parking passes at our West Gate Entrance. According to State and Local regulations, all cars/occupants using ADA Parking need to meet the following requirements: Valid ADA license plate or placard must be displayed visibly on the vehicle. When asked, an occupant of the vehicle must be able to present a valid Pennsylvania Department of Transportation ADA Certificate with appropriate identification of the recipient. Person listed on the ADA Certificate must be an occupant of the vehicle. * ADA Parking spaces are limited and are first-come, first-served. Please plan on arriving early for ADA parking needs. The reserved parking lot does not have assigned ADA parking spaces.

For specific questions in regards to hearing impairment/visual impairment seating and services, please contact questions@MoheganArenaPA.com . Wheelchair seating is located in row "S" of the lower level (100) level sections. Row "S" is located on the concourse level and does not involve any stairs. The elevator only services the floor and suite level. The only way to get to the second level (200) level is via stairs. Those persons with limited mobility, but not complete restrictions are ask to purchase seating in row "Q" or row "R" of the lower level. There are about 5 stairs to get to row R, Q is in front of that. Mohegan Arena does not have wheelchairs for public use at events.
