evidence.heading: Bags, Containers & Coolers
evidence.text: Backpacks (including clear backpacks) are NOT permitted inside Oracle Park. Accommodations are made for diaper bags, medical bags and guests with accessible needs. Otherwise this policy is strictly enforced and exceptions will not be made. Other bags, that do not exceed 16" x 16" x 8" in size, are permitted: paper and plastic grocery bags, purses, fanny packs, lunch bags, briefcases, diaper bags, soft-sided coolers, and handbags. Hard-sided coolers are not permitted. Bags do not need to be clear.

evidence.heading: Kids Run The Bases

Please be aware of any particular circumstances that may affect this event such as a change in game time. Refer to the Giants current season schedule for any affected dates. Children and their parents must exit the ballpark after the game and re-enter at the right field viewing portal from the Portwalk. After guests have finished running the bases, they will be directed out of the ballpark by event staff behind home plate. The promotion is held at the discretion of management.

evidence.heading: Disability Parking & Shuttle
evidence.text: Due to security measures in place around the stadium, vehicles without East and West Stadium Parking Permits are not able to pass through police checkpoints to drop off guests near the stadium. However, you may be able to drop off along Lane Avenue near St. John Arena (traffic can be very heavy at times) and then board the ADA shuttle to Ohio Stadium.

evidence.heading: West Campus Shuttle
evidence.text: NEW LOCATION: A complimentary shuttle service will transport guests from the West Campus Lots (Carmack Lots near Kenny Road & Woody Hayes Drive) to the Campus Transit Hub (located off John Herrick Drive near the Lincoln Tower fields). The West Campus pickup spot is in front of Mount Hall. The Transit Hub drop off is conveniently located just south of Ohio Stadium near the recreational tennis courts. This shuttle will operate from 6 hours prior kickoff until 1 hour after the game. The shuttles are large transit busses, which additionally have a wheelchair lift and can accommodate up to two wheelchairs at a time if needed.

evidence.heading: Rideshare
evidence.text: Rideshare vehicles are required to pickup and drop off in one of two designated locations on gamedays. Rideshare vehicles will not be able to access any streets in or around Ohio Stadium. When requesting a ride through a rideshare app, you will likely be directed to one of the two designated locations - you will not be able to direct the drivers closer to Ohio Stadium. Rideshares can pickup/dropoff along Borror Drive near the Schottenstein Center OR they may stop at 19th & Neil Avenue in Central Campus.

evidence.heading: Party Bus & Livery/Limo Vehicle Parking
evidence.text: Drivers from the vehicle company must remain with the vehicle, and the vehicle must remain on site at all times. Drivers & vehicles will not be permitted to exit the area and return later for a pickup.

evidence.heading: Lost and Found at Ohio Stadium
evidence.text: Lost and Found is located at 5A Guest Services and remains open for 30 minutes after the event. If you need to try to find your item after the event has ended and you have left the facility, submit a Lost Item Report online and we will try to match it up with the items that were found/logged. Reports will be viewed on the next business day (i.e. our facilities may be closed on the weekends). Found items that have been matched to your Lost Item Report will be mailed/shipped directly to you or can be held for pickup for 30 days following the event. Guests are responsible for the mailing/shipping fees. To search or report a lost item, please report it by submitting a Lost Item Report .

Your booking data will be automatically deleted after two years. Your user account is automatically deleted after two years of inactivity.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: Access to the Berlin Olympic Stadium Grounds All visitors can enter the grounds of the Berlin Olympic Stadium through the East Gate and South Gate. In general, visitors are free to choose which entrance to use. The policy regarding assistance for wheelchair users may vary from one event organizer to another. If we have specific information on this topic, we will make it publicly available on our website in the event details for the respective event.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: Stadium Grounds: The entrances to the lower concourse at blocks C/D, G/H, J/K, N, Q/R, and S/T are wheelchair accessible. From there, the seats designated for wheelchair users and the regular seating areas can be easily reached. All wheelchair-accessible seats are located on the inner concourse in the East Curve (sections Q, R, S, T), in the Marathontor area (sections G, H, J, K), on the opposite grandstand in section N, and in the VIP grandstand.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: For accompanying persons, stadium seats are provided directly between and next to all wheelchair spaces; these seats can be flexibly adjusted using a rail system.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: There are also a sufficient number of concession stands and accessible restrooms in the lower ring. Our VIP areas are also accessible.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: Here you can download a map of the lower tier. It shows all the wheelchair-accessible seats, the corresponding access routes to those seats, and accessible restrooms.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: People who use wheelchairs are warmly welcome to join our guided tours and visits to the Berlin Olympic Stadium. The five-star stadium is generally barrier-free and accessible to people with limited mobility. However, unrestricted mobility is not always possible within the seating sections; for example, the upper tier is accessible only by stairs.

evidence.heading: Accessibility at the Stadium
evidence.text: If you are a wheelchair user and would like to book a tour, please let us know in advance. The non-public areas can be accessed via elevators, which we’ll be happy to unlock for you. However, the elevators are not available during concert setup and takedown. This is another reason why it’s important for us to be notified in advance of participants who use wheelchairs.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: If you plan to attend an event at one of our four venues, you can purchase advance tickets at The Paramount Box Office. The box office is located at the intersection of 9th Avenue and Pine Street in downtown Seattle and is open from Monday to Friday, between 10am and 6pm. Additionally, the box offices at all four venues open 90 minutes before the showtime to assist with day of show ticketing needs only.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: You can purchase tickets by clicking the “Get Tickets” button on our website or by visiting the box office to check availability and pricing.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: STG box office fees: Tickets purchased in person at our box offices are exempt from online ticketing fees. The only fee charged at the box office is the Facility Fee which supports our historic venues. The Paramount Box Office is open Monday through Friday from 10am to 6pm for advance sales. All venues open 90 minutes before showtime for that day’s performances.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: Mobile tickets can be scanned right off your smartphone on the night of the event and do not need to be printed. You will likely need to adjust your screen brightness for our ticket scanners to be able to read the barcode on your mobile ticket. As a security measure, barcodes do not populate on mobile tickets until 72 hours before the performance. If it is a show in which the artist allows ticket purchasers to transfer their tickets to other parties, then that action can start once the barcode has populated (72 hours before performance time). Not all artists permit tickets to be transferred.

Service animals are welcome inside the venue, but must, at all times, remain on a leash or in a harness. Service animals should rest in the seating area of the individual with a disability, rather than in the aisle. A guest whose service animal poses a threat to the safety of other Pechanga Arena San Diego guests and employees may be asked to escort the animal off the premises.

evidence.text: Service animals are welcomed at Petco Park. In keeping with U.S. ADA regulations, disabled guests may use either a dog or miniature horse that is individually trained to do work or perform tasks for the guest. The work or tasks performed by the service animal must be directly related to the guest's disability. Animals that solely provide emotional support or companionship to a guest will not be permitted inside the ballpark.

Guests with disabilities may bring factory-sealed plastic or paper containers that contain liquids required for medical reasons into the ballpark.

evidence.heading: Re-Entry
evidence.text: Fans needing to exit and re-enter Progressive Field must do so through a dedicated gate at the Left Field Gate. Their game ticket or seat locator will be scanned upon exit. To re-enter the Ballpark, fans will enter through the security checkpoint and turnstiles where their ticket or seat locator will be re-scanned. During the games in which a gate giveaway is taking place, fans leaving the exit gate will have their ticket scanned and marked so that they may not receive multiple promotional items.

evidence.heading: Smoking
evidence.text: Progressive Field is a non-smoking facility in accordance with the laws of the state of Ohio. Fans are not permitted to smoke or use tobacco products anywhere on Progressive Field property. Electornic Cigarettes, "E-Cigarettes", Vapr Cigarettes, or any device that mimics smoking are also prohibited. Should fans need to smoke, the may use the re-entry gate in Left field to leave the park.

evidence.heading: Will Call
evidence.text: Due to renovations of the ballpark, the Box Office will no longer be an option for fans to purchase tickets. All tickets need to be purchased digitally .Effective at the start of the 2024 season, Progressive Field will be a cashless venue. All purchases inside the ballpark must be made with a credit or debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Guards Mobile Wallet. Additionally, and at no charge, fans can convert cash to a prepaid card via reverse ATM machines that can be used for purchases inside and outside the ballpark.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
evidence.text: What is Guards Wallet and how does it work? Guards Wallet is a centralized payment system integrated into the MLB Ballpark app that allows fans to quickly and easily pay for tickets, concessions and merchandise at the ballpark. Fans only need to store their credit card information once, and they can use it for all in-venue purchases without having to re-enter payment details, while also being able to access any value, discounts, or other Club provided benefits. This simplifies the in-venue purchasing process by providing a single payment method for food and merchandise while streamlining transactions, reducing friction, and allowing fans to focus more on enjoying the game rather than worrying about utilizing multiple payment methods for one transaction.

evidence.heading: Automatic Teller Machines (ATMs)
evidence.text: ATMs are located behind home plate and in centerfield on the 100 Level; behind home plate and near section 540 on the Upper Level; outside Gate 4; in the service tunnel outside of the Leinenkugel’s Craft Lodge; and outside of ChiSox Bar & Grill. Please note Rate Field is cashless.

evidence.heading: Bike Racks
evidence.text: A limited number of bike racks are located outside Rate Field between Gates 2 and 3 and along 35th Street near Gate 5. There is also a DIVVY station located outside of Gate 6 on 35th Street.

evidence.heading: Champions Monument Plaza
evidence.text: Champions Plaza and the Champions Moment Monument, located outside Gate 4, celebrates the 2005 World Series Champion White Sox and our fans. The diamond-shaped plaza consists of a limited number of bricks inscribed with personalized fan messages (Bricks are no longer available for purchase) , surrounded by engraved pavers commemorating great moments and players in White Sox history. The granite and bronze sculpture that stands at the heart of the plaza depicts and highlights key plays, players and moments of the team's amazing march through October of the Championship 2005 season. The plaza and sculpture were unveiled in April 2008.

evidence.heading: Chicago White Sox Team Store, A Fanatics Experience
evidence.text: The Chicago White Sox Team Store is located at Gate 5 of Rate Field on the north side of 35th Street and consists of nearly 12,000 square feet of sales space. The Team Store offers shoppers the best selection of White Sox merchandise.

evidence.heading: Chicago White Sox Team Store, A Fanatics Experience
evidence.text: Entrance/Exit after games: After the last out, the Gate 5 bridge doors are for entry only. Please exit the store through the Main Level Entrance after checkout. Guests may enter the store on the main level after the last out, until closing.

evidence.heading: CIBC Scout Club
evidence.text: This all-inclusive area is accessible to guests holding a CIBC Scout Club ticket. Guests may enter through the entrance at Gate 3 1/2. This area is also accessible through the Main (100) Level seating area directly behind home plate. No food or drink may leave this area. For more information about the CIBC Scout Club, visit Premium Seating .

evidence.heading: ChiSox Bar & Grill
evidence.text: Located at Gate 5, ChiSox Bar & Grill offers a great place to meet friends and family before, during and after the game! For more information on food and beverage offerings, guaranteed promo offering and more, please visit whitesox.com/chisox .

evidence.heading: Leinenkugel's Craft Lodge
evidence.text: Located in the Patio Area, the bar opens when the gates to the ballpark open and remains open one hour after the conclusion of the game. Guests should enter from the stairs in section 106/107. Children under the age of 21 must be accompanied by parent/guardian. A guest may not re-enter the Craft Lodge after leaving the ballpark. Smoking is NOT permitted in The Leinenkugel's Craft Lodge.

evidence.heading: Promotional Item Guidelines
evidence.text: Sized items cannot be exchanged after clearing the distribution area. Only one (1) item may be received per person, not per ticket. If you have purchased multiple tickets, you must exit the ballpark after receiving your giveaway item and re-enter the ballpark to receive an additional item with a new scanned ticket.

evidence.heading: Box Office Operations
evidence.text: Tickets can be purchased in person at the Box Office during their open hours or at whitesox.com/tickets.

evidence.heading: Gift Cards
evidence.text: Gift cards are available for purchase at the Team Store and all retail locations inside of the ballpark. Gift cards can be redeemed at the Rate Field Box Office, the Team Store, and permanent concession stands.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: Tickets to all Chicago White Sox games are sent as mobile tickets via email. Fans will need to have created a White Sox ticket account and present his/her smart telephone at the gate to gain entry. Any fan having issues with his/her telephone or does not have a smartphone should be directed to any open ticket window for assistance.
How to Access Your Mobile Tickets

evidence.heading: What if I cannot find tickets I purchased or tickets that were forwarded to me?
evidence.text: Note that you may need to refresh your Tickets tab by pulling down on the screen to see updated ticket inventory. If your White Sox tickets were originally forwarded to you by another MLB Ballpark app user, the original sender may have canceled the forward and you should check with the person who sent you the tickets. If you are still having difficulty locating mobile tickets you believe should be appearing in your Tickets tab, contact White Sox Fan Services at seasontickets@chisox.com or 312-674-1000.

evidence.heading: What is a Mobile Ticket Barcode?

evidence.heading: How do I access the ticket to scan for entry?
evidence.text: Tap on an individual ticket from the Tickets tab’s Wallet to pull up the mobile ticket barcode. The Section/Row/Seat and barcode will be displayed along with access to the terms and conditions governing your ticket.

evidence.heading: ADA ACCOMODATIONS +
evidence.text: Raymond James Stadium and its amenities were carefully designed to provide an enjoyable experience for all guests within the guidelines of the Americans with Disabilities Act. Disabled and wheelchair seating is available throughout RJS. For more information, please ask for the Accessibility Guide at any Guest Services booth. Go to Accessibility by clicking here .

evidence.heading: DISABLED DROP-OFF & PICK UP AREA +
evidence.text: East side drop-off: Southbound Himes Ave turn lane onto to Tampa Bay Blvd, between Lot B/C entrance and Tampa Bay Blvd. This drop off location is accessible by traveling south on Himes Ave only.

evidence.heading: DISABLED DROP-OFF & PICK UP AREA +
evidence.text: Entrances for guests with disabilities with general tickets are located at Ford Gate and Suzuki Marine Gate. Guests with disabilities with club/suite tickets have access to elevators located just inside the club/suite entrance. Escalators and ramps are also located at each gate.

evidence.heading: ENTRANCE GATES +
evidence.text: GUESTS SHOULD LOOK ON THEIR TICKET FOR WHERE TO ENTER THE STADIUM. THERE ARE FOUR GATES: FORD GATE, B, SUZUKI MARINE, AND FIFTH THIRD BANK GATE THAT ARE FOR GENERAL ADMISSIONS GUESTS. Guests who have club access or have suite tickets may enter in the specific entrance for the Hyundai West Club or the East Club. SPECIAL ENTRANCES FOR GUESTS WITH DISABILITIES ARE LOCATED NEAR THE RAMPS AT THE FORD GATE AND THE SUZUKI MARINE GATE.

evidence.heading: ESCALATORS +
evidence.text: ESCALATORS ARE LOCATED AT THE FORD GATE, GATE B, SUZUKI MARINE GATE AND THE FIFTH THIRD BANK GATE AS WELL AS IN EACH OF THE CLUBS. THE DIRECTION OF ESCALATORS ADJUSTS FOR TRAFFIC FLOW MIDWAY THROUGH EVENTS.

evidence.heading: GUEST SERVICES BOOTHS +
evidence.text: Guest Services booths are located on the main concourse near sections 102, 119, 127, and 144; on the upper concourse near sections 310 and 336; in the club lobbies inside the entrance and club lounges next to the escalators as well as outside the stadium in the South Plaza, Ford Gate, and Gate B. Guest Service booth attendants assist guests with lost and found, lost children or fans, emergencies, Designated Driver program, wheelchair storage, stadium directions and questions.

evidence.heading: PARKING +
evidence.text: Parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. There are approximately 10,000 spots on-site, as well as 15,000 off-site. Patrons pay for parking upon entrance into the lot. All parking lots require cashless payment. All vehicles that enter RJS property are subject to search. Prices vary each event, as do designated lots for different types of vehicles (motorcycles, buses, campers, limos, etc.). Follow the directions on the message boards on the roadways leading to the stadium for reserved, general or disabled lots. Advance parking is available for Buccaneers, Bulls, Outback Bowl and select other events. Contact USF, the Buccaneers or the Outback Bowl for more information on advance parking.

evidence.heading: ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE +
evidence.text: For roadside assistance in the parking lots, call the Stadium Office at 813-350-6501 , raise your car hood, or notify an officer at any lot entrance. Assistance includes gas, lockout, and dead battery.

evidence.heading: VERANDA TAILGATES +
evidence.text: We have four veranda tailgates, two located outside of each club entrance. The space is available to rent for private parties, tailgates and more. Please submit a host your event form for more information.

evidence.text: If you lose an item during a Rogers Stadium event, please check in with Guest Services at Gate 1 to see if it has been found. evidence.heading: Bag Policy
evidence.text: For Everyone’s safety, security, and enjoyment, we ask you to only bring SMALL clutches, belt bags, fanny-packs or bags that are clear (i.e. see-through) to allow us to safely and efficiently screen and welcome fans into the event. The maximum allowable bag size is 12” x 6” x 12” (30cm x 15cm x 30cm) , including purses. Bags exceeding 6” x 9” (15cm x 23cm), but smaller than 12” x 6” x 12” (30cm x 15cm x 30cm) must be single compartment and clear on all sides . Bags smaller than 6” x 9” (15cm x 23cm), also referred to as a “clutch style” bag, are not required to be clear. ANY BACKPACKS WILL NOT BE PERMITTED . All event attendees and items will be subject to search when entering the venue. Any individual who leaves the premises and attempts to re-enter the venue must be researched, including their bags and/or carried items.

evidence.heading: ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Accessible/Disabled seating is available on the lower level of the arena. Wheelchair area is located behind sections 113 and 116 (depending on event set-up behind sections 105 and 108 may also be available). Wheelchairs must purchase a ticket to these areas only. There is no access to main floor or other seating areas. If you can walk with assistance tickets can be purchased in any section but wheelchair can’t be stored at or near your seat. Tickets for accessible seating areas are available through Ticketmaster and the Allstate Arena Box Office. When ordering tickets for an accessible seating area, it is important to indicate that you require accessible seating so we can properly seat you. Please note that the number of seats available in the accessible seating area meets the requirements of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) and other laws relating to accessibility, however, the number of seats in the accessible seating areas is limited. Tickets for seats in the accessible seating areas are sold on a first come, first served basis.

Several options are available including stair-free access and an open space to accommodate a variety of mobility devices including wheelchairs and motorized scooters. Alternatively, an upholstered loose chair can be provided. Aisle seating in seats with folding armrests are available upon request. A limited number of seats are reserved for patrons with low vision or blindness, which are located towards the front and center of the section. All ticket sales are final; there are no refunds or exchanges.

In order to ensure you can park as close as possible we recommend arriving when parking gates open.Please note: SoFi Stadium honors any state-issued accessible parking placard for a vehicle that fits in a 9’ x 18’ parking space without impeding the people on either side of your vehicle. Oversized vehicles (e.g. stretch limos, RVs, buses, etc.) with a disabled parking placard will not be allowed to park in an accessible parking space.

evidence.heading: Prohibited & Permitted Items
evidence.text: Service Animal Policy: A service animal is a dog or a miniature horse that has been individually trained to perform tasks directly related to a person’s disability. The guest and their service animal may be asked to leave if the animal is “out of control” or not housebroken. Animals must be on a leash, harness, or other type of restraint at all times unless the owner is unable to retain an animal on a leash due to a disability. The owner must be in full control of the animal at all times. The care and supervision of the animal is solely the responsibility of the owner. Service animals are not required to wear a vest. Please ask any of our Guest Experience Staff for directions to the animal relief area.

evidence.heading: M

evidence.heading: W
evidence.text: For designated events, complimentary wheelchair escorts are available at any entry point. Upon arrival guests may request an escort by locating the nearest Guest Experience Representative. The service is available to and from the entry gates and seating areas. Please be aware that our staff and wheelchair will not remain with you during the event. Wheelchair lifts have a 750 lbs capacity and are 58.5" long x 43.65" wide, with a 80.37" height x 35.7" wide door.

evidence.text: For NFL games, SoFi Stadium parking lots will open 4 to 5 hours before kickoff. Entry gates open 2-3 hours prior to kickoff. Please plan on arriving as soon as parking gates open to avoid traffic delays!

evidence.heading: Concerts and Non-NFL Games

evidence.heading: SoFi Stadium Hyundai Parking Zones & Maps
evidence.text: It is imperative that guests download the digital parking pass into their smartphone applications and are ready to show it to parking staff at the designated checkpoints. All parking passes will be color coded to match the parking zone. Guests must enter the correct entry gate to the assigned parking zones. Once guests enter the correct zone entry, guests will be directed to a parking lot and a parking space by parking staff. Please follow all instructions provided by Parking staff. For guests that desire to park near a friend, both parties must have parking passes for the same zone and arrive together. Parking spaces cannot be reserved or saved for guests arriving at a later time. Drive aisles must remain clear at all times. No items (coolers, tents, tables, chairs, etc.) of any kind may be placed in the ground behind, in front of or around parked vehicles. These items are only permitted within the designated tailgating zone.

evidence.heading: Mobile Ticketing Guide
evidence.text: Mobile tickets and parking passes have been the primary ticket delivery method for all ticketed Stanford athletic events since 2021 . In an effort to further modernize and advance the ticketing experience for fans, Stanford Athletics changed ticketing system providers and unveiled the redesigned Stanford Cardinal mobile app on July 1, 2023. These technology advancements have brought a refreshed ticket website and ticket purchase flow at tickets.gostanford.com, streamlined mobile ticket downloads with season ticket passes, expedited venue entry, and much more.

evidence.heading: How-to Guide
evidence.text: All mobile tickets will be ‘Tap and Go’ tickets and will not have barcodes. Once a ticket is added to Apple or Google Wallet, it is associated with that iCloud or Google account and cannot be stored in another wallet account unless removed. Please review the “Where is the QR code on my ticket?” section below for further information. Screenshots will not be accepted for entry.

evidence.heading: How-to Guide
evidence.text: Instead of a barcode or QR code, your mobile tickets will prompt you to hover your smartphone near the ticket scanner to scan into events. When you arrive at the venue, open your mobile wallet, navigate to your tickets for the event and hold your device near the ticket scanner to scan in to the event. If you have multiple tickets in your mobile wallet, you can scroll horizontally to display and scan additional tickets.

evidence.heading: How-to Guide
evidence.text: You should download your mobile tickets as soon as possible after completing your purchase and prior to arriving at the event. Once a ticket is added to Apple or Google Wallet, it is associated with that iCloud or Google account and cannot be stored in another wallet account unless removed. Tickets stored in your mobile wallet will automatically update when game times are set, can be easily opened from your device’s home screen on the day of the event, and do not require Wi-Fi or cellular service to be accessed. Screenshots will not be accepted for entry.

evidence.heading: ATMs and Reverse ATM’s
evidence.text: Target Field has one traditional U.S. Bank ATM located on the Main Concourse in the elevator lobby near Section 112. Please note, concessions and retail locations at Target Field do not accept cash. Target Field also has five reverse ATM’s, which can be used to load cash onto pre-paid debit cards. These are located on the Main Concourse inside Gate 29 and in the elevator lobby near Gate 3; on the Treasure Island Home Run Deck near Section 231; and on the Terrace Concourse near the top of both the Right Field and Left Field escalators. There is no transaction fee to use the reverse ATM’s.

evidence.heading: Bag Storage
evidence.text: Prohibited bags may be securely stored at no charge during Twins home games. The bag storage area is located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station. Please note, all bags will be searched prior to being stored.

evidence.heading: Bicycle Parking
evidence.text: The Minnesota Twins encourage guests to ride their bicycle to Target Field. There is a secure, staffed bike corral located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station, and guests are encouraged to store their bike in this area. There is no charge for this service. For more information, visit twins.com/transportation .

evidence.heading: Carbliss Clubhouse
evidence.text: The Carbliss Clubhouse is a lounge located in the left field corner at Target Field, near section 127 and Gate 6. The Carbliss Clubhouse has several monitors so guests can follow the Twins and other Major League Baseball games. The lounge has tiered standing-room drink rails facing the field, several high-top tables, and a cabana-style seating area. The entire area also featuees overhead radiant heaters.

evidence.heading: Elevators
evidence.text: There are 13 public elevators located throughout Target Field. Elevators 1 & 2 are in the Administrative Office building near Gate 6. Elevators 3 & 4 are located across from Section 125. Elevators 6 & 7 are located across from Section 112. Elevators 9-12 are located across from Section 103. Elevator 13 is located across from Section 133, and elevator 14 is located at Gate 3. Elevator T1 is located near the entrance to Truly On Deck.

evidence.heading: Entry Guidelines
evidence.text: Aerosols and Self-Defense Sprays may not be carried into Target Field. These items may be stored for free at any entry gate and picked-up at that same gate upon leaving Target Field.

evidence.heading: Entry Guidelines
evidence.text: For the general safety of all guests the following items are not allowed into Target Field: ball retrievers, balloons, bats, beach balls, boom boxes, brooms, fireworks, flasks, Frisbees, coolers, inflatables, laser pointers, lawn chairs, noise-making devices, weapons, wooden sticks, or rods. Small whiskbrooms and small souvenir bats are permitted. Guests will have the option of surrendering the item at the gate, leaving and then returning without the prohibited item prior to entering the ballpark, or storing the item in a locker outside Gate 6 prior to entering the ballpark. Surrendered items will not be returned to guests.

evidence.heading: Firearms
evidence.text: The Minnesota Twins prohibit firearms from being carried into Target Field, even for guests with valid conceal-and-carry permits. The only exception to this policy is for licensed Public Law Enforcement officials. Law Enforcement Officers will be required to check-in with Law Enforcement personnel at the gates and present valid Law Enforcement credentials. Firearms may not be stored in the lockers outside of Gate 6.

evidence.heading: Re-entry
evidence.text: Guests may not leave Target Field and re-enter once they have entered the facility.

evidence.heading: Smoking
evidence.text: Target Field is a tobacco and cannabis-free facility. Tobacco and cannabis use is not allowed anywhere within Target Field or its appurtenant areas. This includes the ballpark itself, Target Plaza, the Promenade behind the ballpark, and the 5th and 7th Street sidewalks adjacent to Target Field. The use of vaporizers of any sort is also prohibited at Target Field. There is no re-entry at Target Field.

evidence.heading: Contactless Ordering and Payments
evidence.text: The MLB Ballpark app provides guests the ability to order and purchase food, beverage, and merchandise throughout Target Field directly from their mobile device. The app will automatically provide menus and items from the closest concessions and/or retail locations to the guest’s ticketed seat, while also allowing the guest to order from any food, beverage, or retail location throughout Target Field. Pre-packaged order pick up from separate, designated “grab-and-go” stations will complete the contactless dining and/or retail experience. The mobile wallet function within the MLB Ballpark app supports all major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

evidence.heading: Drop-Off Zone
evidence.text: Guests with limited mobility may use either of the Drop Off Zones along 7th Street, near both the New Era Team Store and Gate 14. No accessible parking permit is required to use these Drop-Off Zones, but these are strictly drop off zones with no parking permitted in either zone.

evidence.heading: Guest Service Centers
evidence.text: Guests needing assistance are encouraged to speak with one of our Guest Service Representatives or visit one of our Guest Service Centers located near Section 113 on the Main Concourse and near Section 204 on the Terrace Level, at the Thrivent Club Concierge Desk across from 573, or at the Premier Suite Concierge Desk near Suite 32. The Guest Service Centers are staffed to handle questions and/or concerns and offer a wide variety of services and items including ALDs (assistive listening devices), wheelchair service to and from seats, stroller drop off/storage, lost and found, Target Field and public relations information, and convenience items (i.e. sunscreen, diapers, band-aids, etc.) These Centers also serve as the location for reporting lost guests and answering guest pages during the game. The Guest Service Centers are also designed to provide mothers with semi-private accommodations for nursing.

evidence.heading: Keepers Heart Town Ball Tavern
evidence.text: Considered by many to be the comfiest venue at Target Field, the Keeper's Heart Town Ball Tavern celebrates the great teams, players and ballparks in Minnesota's rich town ball history. Enjoy the signature pub food and drinks while you stay on top of the latest scores on the real-time scrolling scoreboard. Order your food through MLB Ballpark app to pick up on the way to your seats.

evidence.heading: Taxi Service
evidence.text: The Target Field taxi stand is located between Gates 29 and 14 on 7th Street. Please visit us online at twins.com/transportation for more information.

evidence.heading: Drop-Off/Pick Up Areas
evidence.text: Guests with mobility issues may use either of the Drop-Off Zones along 7th Street, near both the New Era Team Store and Gate 14. No accessible parking permit is required to use these Drop-Off Zones, but they are strictly drop-off zones, with no parking permitted in these zones.”

Pre-packaged order pick up from separate, designated “grab-and-go” stations will complete the contactless dining and/or retail experience. evidence.heading: Suites and Club Areas
evidence.text: The Premier Suite Level and all individual suites at Target Field are fully wheelchair accessible. The Premier Suite Level can be accessed by first entering through either Ramp A or Gate 29 and then taking elevators 9-12 to the Premier Suite Level. A guest drop-off area is located outside of Gate 29 and Gate 14 for guests with mobility issues. All gates at Target Field are wheelchair accessible. If a guest that utilizes a wheelchair will be attending a game in a private suite, we will remove an exterior chair to allow that guest access to view the game from the balcony of the suite. A 24-hour notice is appreciated to best prepare the suite for that guest.

evidence.heading: At Bat Troubleshooting
evidence.text: If you're receiving "Authentication Failed" or "Authorizing" errors when attempting to play live MLB, please navigate to the MLB app > Account Settings, then tap on "Log Out." Re-enter your registered MLB email and password. You may receive this message if you recently reset your MLB password, but did not update the stored login information, or if you don't have an active subscription.

evidence.heading: At Bat Troubleshooting
evidence.text: If you're receiving "Connection" errors and have purchased At Bat or MLB.TV from Apple iTunes, please attempt to initially connect or re-connect your purchase to a new or existing MLB account. Navigate to the MLB app Browse > Account, tap on "MLB Account," then tap on "Log Out." Re-enter your MLB account email and password (or create a new account), then connect your purchase by tapping on "Connect purchase to MLB."

evidence.heading: Restrooms

evidence.heading: Service Animals
evidence.text: Service animals are defined by the ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) as dogs or miniature horses that are trained to do work to perform tasks related to people with disabilities. The work or task the service animal is trained to do must directly relate to the person's disability. Service Animals must be housebroken. Service Animals are required to behave and not repeatedly bark, growl, jump up on or lunge at other guests or employees. Corrective action must be taken if the service animal is not behaving appropriately.

evidence.heading: Service Animals
evidence.text: Dogs whose sole function is to provide comfort or emotional support do not qualify as service animals under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Comfort animals, emotional support animals, and therapy dogs are not listed as service animals under Title III of the ADA. This also applies to the other species of animals wild or domestic, trained, or untrained. The ADA requires the service animal to be under the control of the handler. This may include using a harness, leash, or other tether. Our venue employees are not required to provide for, the care, or supervision of a service animal, including cleaning up after it. Service Animals must remain on the floor and are not allowed on dining chairs, bars, or tables in our food and beverage locations. Live Nation and our operating partners have the right to deny access to a dog that disrupts our operations.

evidence.heading: Where are your entrance gates?
evidence.text: There are two main entry gates - West Gate and East Gate. Accessibility Gates are available for use at each entrance regardless of the ticket type. Fast Lanes are located at both entrances and clearly labeled with signage, fans must have a Fast Lane pass to utilize these entry lanes. The VIP Lounge has a separate entry gate located next to the East Box Office. All guests using this gate must be VIP clients and have the appropriate ticket. NOTE: Some shows will only have one entrance gate open. Be sure to check your email, our social posts, and the Know Before You Go page for specific information about your show.

evidence.heading: How do you handle emergencies?
evidence.text: In the event of an emergency while on site, Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre has trained paramedics to assist with any medical issues. First aid is located near the west entrance, but any staff member with a radio can dispatch First Aid to the location needed. Local law enforcement officers are also on site for every event and can assist if needed or requested. Venue management works closely with all appropriate emergency agencies and services to ensure that we are up to date on any dangerous weather or potential crowd related issues.

evidence.heading: I haven't received my VIP details and my event is within 24 hours.

If you have additional questions about your VIP check-in, please contact the official VIP provider.

evidence.heading: Where are the drop-off and pick-up areas?
evidence.text: Rideshare drop-off is on the west side of the venue through Gate 3. Let parking staff know you’re dropping off and they’ll show you the way. When picking up, arrive 45 minutes before the end of the show—you won’t be able to enter otherwise. To find your rideshare, head to Palm Lane on the southwest side of the venue.

evidence.heading: Are there specific accessible entrances?

evidence.heading: Do you have accessible parking?
evidence.text: Accessible Parking is located inside Gate 3 & Gate 6 off of Encanto Blvd. Upon arrival on event day, inform parking staff that you need accessible parking and they will direct you to the closest lot. A visible, state-issued plate or placard is required to use an accessible parking spot. Accessible parking is subject to availability and first-come, first-served. To ensure you can park as close as possible, we recommend arriving when the parking lots open.

DROP-OFF AND PICK-UP AREAS Find them on the west side of the venue through Gate 3. Let parking staff know you’re dropping off and they’ll show you the way. evidence.heading: 50/50 Raffle
evidence.text: The Atlanta Braves Foundation will sell 50/50 raffle tickets from the time gates open until the bottom of the seventh inning. Fans can purchase tickets from anywhere in Georgia by visiting braves.com/5050, or from uniformed raffle sellers while in Truist Park or The Battery Atlanta. The jackpot total will be updated and displayed in real time throughout the game. At the end of each raffle, the winning number will be posted on the LED board located in left field below the Coca-Cola Home Run Porch and on braves.com/5050raffle . The winning ticket may be claimed at the guest services booth located at Section 120. Winner does not have to be present to win.

evidence.text: 6. The ATLANTA BRAVES reserve the right to remove any guest who is being unruly or disruptive due to his or her intoxication, as well as deny any individual who appears intoxicated during his or her entry into Truist Park. Guests over 21 years old with International identification other than a Passport (in English), may present their ID to a DELAWARE NORTH SPORTSERVICE international ID trained representative at the Designated Driver Kiosk (near the Chop House Restaurant entrance.) Upon validation, the guest will receive a tamperproof gold wristband printed with “International ID Verified”. Guests may then present their ID for positive match, and wristband at any location to purchase / receive an alcoholic beverage.

evidence.heading: Autograph Policy
evidence.text: Fans may request autographs from the time gates open until 1 hour prior to first pitch. At that time, ticket integrity in these areas will begin being enforced. Autographs are not guaranteed and are at the discretion of the player(s).

evidence.heading: Cameras/Camcorders
evidence.text: All cameras must be handheld and the camera lens cannot exceed 5" in length (3" in length for Truist Park Concerts). No tripods or monopods will be permitted. Hand-held video cameras and still cameras for personal use may be brought into the ballpark, provided no game action is recorded in accordance with Major League Baseball regulations. Please be courteous to those guests around you when taking pictures, the equipment may not obstruct the view of other guests. Camera cases must fit through the bag template and will be inspected prior to entrance into the ballpark.

evidence.heading: Clubs
evidence.text: Truist Club (Sections 1-9): The Truist Club is the most exclusive and distinguished Premium Club in Truist Park. It is located directly behind home plate with 58 feet separating you from all the action on the diamond. It features approximately 160 Field-Level luxury seats and flat-panel television monitors mounted throughout the seating area. We celebrate the tradition of Braves baseball inside with game-used autographed bats from Atlanta Braves legends such as Hank Aaron, Chipper Jones, and Dale Murphy. Truist Club Premium Memberships include complimentary Valet parking with easy access to the ballpark through the exclusive entrance at the 1 st Base Premium Lobby. The Truist Club provides an all-inclusive high-end food and beverage menu with a full bar and in-seat service that ensures you won’t miss a second of the game. All amenities open approximately two hours before first pitch.

evidence.heading: Clubs
evidence.text: The Delta SKY360° Club (Sections 22-30 & 122-130): The Delta SKY360° Club is located directly behind home plate. This newly renovated Premium Club is located on Field Level with direct access to the ballpark’s seating bowl. Upgrades to the all-inclusive Club environment include over 8,000 feet of additional square footage, over 600 seated and standing dining spaces, nine food serving stations featuring an everchanging menu of food options ranging from ballpark staples to the latest international trends, three grab-and-go food and beverage locations, two retail shops, and a new 53 footlong Gold Glove Bar. Fans can also enjoy first-class, in-seat service without ever leaving the comfort of their newly padded leather seats. Amenities in this space open approximately two hours before first pitch. Each Premium Membership in the Delta SKY360° includes a complimentary full-season Premium parking pass and a private entrance to the ballpark from the 1 st or 3 rd Base Premium Lobby.

evidence.heading: Clubs

Guests inside can enjoy catering service from personalized suite attendants while being surrounded by state-of-the-art amenities. Champions Suite season leaseholders receive valet parking, catering credit, access to the suite concierge program, and much more.

Re-enter your registered MLB email and password. You may receive this message if you recently reset your MLB password, but did not update the stored login information, or if you don't have an active subscription.

evidence.heading: At Bat Troubleshooting
evidence.text: If you're receiving "Connection" errors and have purchased At Bat or MLB.TV from Apple iTunes, please attempt to initially connect or re-connect your purchase to a new or existing MLB account. Navigate to the MLB app Browse > Account, tap on "MLB Account," then tap on "Log Out." Re-enter your MLB account email and password (or create a new account), then connect your purchase by tapping on "Connect purchase to MLB."

evidence.heading: Accessibility
evidence.text: What accessible toilet facilities do you have? We have three sets of accessible toilets on the ground level accessible to public (Entry B, C and D) plus 4 purpose built unisex facilities on concourse level - these are signed and directly accessed from concourse and are located 2 on Red concourse and 2 on Blue concourse . RADAR locks are used and keys can be obtained from various locations/staff around the venue including:- Information Kiosk on Green Concourse, Arena Club, Utilita Lounge & Entry B Reception. You can also ask any steward or cleaning staff who will be able to assist and direct you to the closest suitable toilet - keys are universal so if you have your own feel free to bring them with you.

evidence.heading: How do I book tickets to Veikkaus Arena events?
evidence.text: Here’s how to use Mobile Only tickets: 1. Purchase your tickets from Ticketmaster. 2. Your order confirmation will be added to your Ticketmaster account and a copy will be sent to you by email. The tickets will be accessible on your Ticketmaster account within 15 minutes of completing the purchase. 3. Log in to you Ticketmaster account via Veikkaus Arena app or Ticketmaster app, or the browser on your smartphone. 4. Open ”My Events” and choose your event from ”Upcoming”. 5. Open your ticket QR code by tapping the ”View Ticket” button. Sometimes it may take a while for the QR code to open, just wait patiently without closing the ticket. 6. Turn up the brightness on your phone screen for quick and easy scanning. You can find more information and guides here! If you have any questions regarding Mobile Only tickets, please contact Ticketmaster Fan Support

evidence.heading: What are your parking policies?

evidence.text: If you have any questions or needs not addressed by this guide, please contact us here or visit the Guest Services Desks located on the Concourse behind Section 121 and on the Mezzanine Level at Section 214 during your event. evidence.heading: The Xfinity Mobile Arena Disability Access Guide
evidence.text: The Xfinity Mobile Arena is committed to ensuring that no individual with a disability is excluded, denied services, segregated or otherwise treated differently than other individuals because of the absence of auxiliary aids and services. The Xfinity Mobile Arena will provide auxiliary aids and services if doing so does not fundamentally alter the nature of its goods and services and it does not impose an undue burden. Because auxiliary aids and services may take time to arrange, it is suggested that individuals who will require the use of such aids or services request these accommodations as far in advance of the event as possible. To make such a request, please contact us here or visit the Guest Services Desks located on the Concourse behind Section 121 and on the Mezzanine Level at Section 214. The Guest Services Desk is staffed during an event from the time the doors open until the conclusion of the event.

evidence.heading: The Xfinity Mobile Arena Disability Access Guide
evidence.text: Patrons needing accessible seating when doors open to the event will be directed to the Guest Services Desk for the availability of such seating, which will be distributed on a first-come, first-serve basis. There is no guarantee that accessible seating will be available at the time of the event.

evidence.heading: The Xfinity Mobile Arena Disability Access Guide
evidence.text: To Purchase Accessible Seating : To purchase accessible seating, visit XfinityMobileArena.com or Ticketmaster.com. After choosing the event for which you wish to purchase tickets, select the FILTERS option on the Find Tickets page to “Show Accessible tickets” and then APPLY FILTERS. You can also purchase tickets in person at the Xfinity Mobile Arena box office. The box office is currently open only on event days, opening three hours before the event start time; however, hours may vary. Please be advised that accessible seating is limited and may sell-out. Subject to availability at the time of purchase, Xfinity Mobile Arena will make this accessible seating available to patrons with disabilities and up to three (3) of their companions.

evidence.heading: The Xfinity Mobile Arena Disability Access Guide
evidence.text: The tickets must be picked up in person at the Xfinity Mobile Arena box office and the patron and the PCA must both be present. If the Xfinity Mobile Arena discovers that the patron or the PCA has misrepresented the purpose of the PCA’s attendance, or that the PCA has acted as a patron instead of performing the functions of the PCA while at an event, the Xfinity Mobile Arena reserves the right to take all appropriate action including ejecting both the PCA and the patron from the event and barring the PCA and the patron from future entry. In addition, in the event that the Xfinity Mobile Arena has reason to believe that its policy regarding the admission of PCAs is being violated, the Xfinity Mobile Arena reserves the right to require the patron to provide documentation showing that the person accompanying the patron and receiving complimentary admission is the patron’s government-funded or paid PCA.

evidence.text: Disabled Services & Accessibility

evidence.heading: Wembley Stadium service information for guests with access requirements
evidence.text: We recognise the need to ensure the experiences we offer at Wembley Stadium can be enjoyed by as many people as possible. We’ve worked with expert partners and specialist user groups (including Level Playing Field, Sport England, Alzheimer’s Society, and Brent Council) to make sure that Wembley Stadium is a welcoming and inclusive venue to all our guests with access requirements. Wembley Park station lift repairs We have been advised by Transport for London (TfL) that the accessible lift connecting Wembley Park Station to ground level on Olympic Way is currently undergoing replacement works and will be out of service until September 2026. Step-free access to the station remains available via the entrance and exit on Bridge Road. For assistance in planning your journey, please visit https://tfl.gov.uk/ . Information about accessible seating

evidence.heading: Wembley Stadium service information for guests with access requirements
evidence.text: • There are 310 places for wheelchair users, each with a personal assistant/companion seat. You’ll find them on every level • We also offer seats to guests with access requirements who do not need a wheelchair user bay. This includes guests with visual or hearing impairment, or guests with other non-visible disabilities • There are a range of different options available, but all come with a personal assistant/companion seat • You can read more about how to purchase accessible tickets here: Purchase Accessible Tickets & Proof of Disability.

evidence.heading: Wembley Stadium service information for guests with access requirements
evidence.text: There are 147 accessible toilets within the stadium. These are all accessed by RADAR key. If you do not own a RADAR key, please request assistance from a steward or Customer Engagement Team member

evidence.heading: Wembley Stadium service information for guests with access requirements
evidence.text: There are now 3 Changing Places units in the stadium, located on Level 1 at Block 104 and another at Block 143 and on the 4th floor near our West Sensory Room at Box 4007. If you require access, please speak to a member of the Customer Engagement team who will be able to direct you. Please remember to bring your own sling if you require to use the hoist.

evidence.heading: Wembley Stadium service information for guests with access requirements
evidence.text: There are lifts and escalators to the concourse , Levels 1,2,3,4 and 5 only of the stadium to make navigation easier for our guests. Dedicated lifts are big enough for two wheelchair users, personal assistants, and an attendant is also available at every entrance. To access your entrance on Level 1 outer concourse, there are 2 large lifts either side of the Main Entrance, which is situated under the Olympic Steps in front of the Stadium at ground level. Our Customer Engagement Team will be able to assist accessing the lifts. Please note that for events that have pitch access, such as concerts or boxing, this is Level B1 and cannot be accessed via lift.

evidence.heading: 50/50 Raffle
evidence.text: Support Cubs Charities’ mission to mobilize the power of sport to champion youth, families and communities by participating in the Cubs Charities 50/50 Raffle. For all Cubs home games during the 2025 regular season, fans in Illinois can purchase raffle tickets online starting at 10 a.m. CT until the end of that day’s game or from a Raffle Ambassador at Wrigley Field when gates open until the bottom of the eighth inning. The winner will receive half of the jackpot total from the game's raffle ticket sales and the other half will benefit Cubs Charities.

evidence.heading: Bike Valet Service
evidence.text: The Cubs offer a free bike valet service for Cubs home games in the alley just east of the main entrance to the CTA Red Line stop on Addison Street. The courtesy valet opens three hours prior to the regular season game's scheduled start time and closes one hour after the game ends. Fans are allowed to bring bicycle helmets into the park to be stored under their seat. In addition to bikes, personal motorized scooters (i.e., electric scooters) can be checked at the Cubs’ Bike Valet Service.

evidence.heading: CD Peacock Trophy Room
evidence.text: Fans can see and enjoy the 2016 World Series Championship trophy in the CD Peacock Trophy Room, located inside the Marquee Gate entrance, adjacent to the Harrison Street Premier Entrance lobby. The CD Peacock Trophy Room will be open to fans on gamedays.

evidence.heading: Champions Gate
evidence.text: A new archway monument to memorialize the club’s 1907, 1908 and 2016 World Series championships will be installed at Gallagher Way this summer. Located at the western entrance to Gallagher Way, "Champions Gate" will be dedicated on Saturday, July 18, when the club celebrates the 10th anniversary of the 2016 World Series championship.

evidence.heading: Charging Stations
evidence.text: Fans can find charging stations in the left field and right field Budweiser Bleacher concourses and on the ramp across from the Addison Street Grill and ballpark entrance for Sections 123-125 and 223-225 (by pole 47) in the concourse.

evidence.heading: Gates
evidence.text: For most games, gates will open 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Gates will open two hours before first pitch for Opening Day, Saturday games and special occasions, unless otherwise specified. Each mobile ticket includes an assigned entry gate to assist with the entry and exit process. Visit Cubs.com/Gates to view Wrigley Field gate locations.

evidence.heading: Nursing Mothers
evidence.text: Nursing mothers seeking a private, quiet accommodation are welcome to use the Mamava Pod nursing station located just inside the Gallagher Way Gate. The Mamava Pod is available to use from the time the gates open until the end of the game. First Aid , located behind home plate on the main concourse, also includes a restroom and dedicated nursing mother’s room.

evidence.heading: BALLPARK ENTRY AND EXIT PROCESS
evidence.text: For most games, gates will open 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Gates will open two hours before first pitch for Opening Day, Saturday games and special occasions, unless otherwise specified. evidence.text: Wheelchair escorts are available for guests who may require additional assistance to and from their seats. A pre-arranged escort will meet a guest at the designated gate and assist the guest to their seat. At the conclusion of the event, an escort will return to the guest’s seat and escort them to the nearest exit. Please note the escort will not remain with the guest during the event, nor will the wheelchair be left with a guest during the event. This service is for transport needs only. Additionally, escorts are available only on Grand Casino Arena property and are not permitted to transport beyond the arena property. To arrange a wheelchair escort, please fill out this Guest Services Form .

evidence.heading: Entry and Carry-In Policy
evidence.text: Before proceeding through metal detectors, Guests will be required to remove cellphones, cameras and any large metal objects from their pockets and place them in a small plastic container, which will be visually inspected along with their MLB-compliant bag and small soft-sided personal item, by security personnel at a screening table alongside the metal detector. Only MLB-compliant bags - presently soft-sided and 16 inches by 16 inches by 8 inches or smaller - and small soft-sided personal items, with the exception of empty, reusable, non-glass water bottles that do not exceed 24 oz in size will be admitted. MLB-compliant bags and personal items are subject to a physical search and/or X-ray screening. A Guest's belongings will remain in proximity to the Guest throughout the screening process, and the Guest can pick up his or her belongings at the end of the screening table once he or she has proceeded through the metal detector. Presently, the removal of belts, jackets and shoes is not required.

evidence.heading: ADA/ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Ford Center is committed to guests with disabilities. Our facilities are fully accessible and we provide a wide range of services and amenities for guests with special needs.

evidence.heading: ADA/ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Ford Center is designed with accessible parking, accessible vehicle drop off and pick up areas, power assisted doors, restrooms, concessions and seating areas. Guests can receive more information by visiting our Guest Services Center located on the concourse behind Section 127.

evidence.heading: FAMILY RESTROOMS
evidence.text: Family restrooms are designed for the use of guests with small children and guests with disabilities. However, any guest may use a family restroom. These restrooms are located throughout Ford Center on the concourse. All family restrooms are accessible and equipped with baby changing tables.

evidence.heading: PARKING
evidence.text: Accessible Parking Accessible parking spaces are available in each lot and are available on a first come/first served basis. A state-issued placard or license plate is required to park in accessible parking spaces. The person who has been issued the plate or placard must also be in the vehicle. Violators will be subject to citation and possible revocation of season parking privileges.

evidence.heading: RESTROOMS
evidence.text: There are public restrooms (men, women and family) conveniently located throughout Ford Center. All restrooms are accessible to our guests with disabilities.

evidence.heading: TICKETS
evidence.text: ADA (American Disabilities Act) TICKET FRAUD ADA ticket fraud includes, but is not limited to, the misrepresentation of a disability. Management reserves the right to take appropriate action regarding misrepresentation, which may result in relocation, revocation of tickets without refund or ejection. Please notify your immediate supervisor if you suspect ADA ticket fraud.

evidence.heading: WEBSITE
evidence.text: WHEELCHAIR AND COMPANION SEATING

evidence.heading: WHEELCHAIR AND COMPANION SEATING
evidence.text: Ford Center provides wheelchair and companion seating on the concourse level. Be advised that Ford Center personnel reserve the right to take appropriate legal action against individuals who fraudulently obtain wheelchair and companion seats. For event day assistance and seating relocations, contact an event staff member or visit the Guest Services Center located on the concourse behind Section 127.

evidence.heading: ENTRANCES
evidence.text: There is one (1) guest entrance to Ford Center. All guests should use the South Entrance, located on the South side of Ford Center through the plaza.

evidence.heading: MEDIA ENTRANCE
evidence.text: The entrance for the media is located on the east side of Ford Center in the middle of the concourse. Only members of the media with proper credentials or other predetermined guests may use this entrance. Upon entering, bags will be inspected and tagged accordingly.

evidence.heading: PASSENGER DROP-OFF & PICK-UP ZONES
evidence.text: The passenger pick-up and drop-off area for Ford Center can vary based on event. For most major events, you can drop-off and pick-up near the Media Entrance on the east side of Ford Center, off of the southbound lanes of Gaylord Parkway. Guests utilizing taxis or ride-sharing services should also use this location and walk to the Tostitos Championship Plaza. For further information, contact Guest Services at (972) 497-4800.

evidence.heading: PROHIBITED ITEMS AND BEHAVIOR
evidence.text: **Exceptions will be made for law enforcement personnel. Off-duty law enforcement personnel with weapons can enter through the South Entrance. They will need to identify they are an off-duty officer and choosing to carry a weapon. At that point their credentials will be verified by Frisco police and they will be permitted to enter.

evidence.heading: RIDESHARE INFORMATION
evidence.text: On event days, the rideshare pick-up and drop-off is located outside of the Media Entrance of Ford Center on Gaylord Parkway.

evidence.heading: TICKETS
evidence.text: TICKET POLICY We value the enthusiasm of our guests, but ask that all guests exercise good judgment and observe our “Code of Conduct.” Guests should respect the rights of others by displaying proper decorum. Guests are required to possess their ticket stub all times once they enter Ford Center. Guests must show their ticket to any Ford Center staff member when requested to do so. Failure to produce a valid event ticket may result in ejection from Ford Center. On event day, guests with ticket issues outside Ford Center should be directed to the ticket office windows (near the south entrance). Guests inside Ford Center should be directed to the Guest Services Center.

evidence.heading: WHEELCHAIRS
evidence.text: A limited number of wheelchairs are available for transporting guests from the gates to their Ford Center seating location. Guests are asked to supply their own wheelchair if they need one for the duration of the event. Guests may arrange for wheelchair assistance by contacting an event staff member at any entrance. Guests needing assistance after the event should contact an event staff member, security personnel or the Guest Services Center located on the concourse behind Section 127.

evidence.text: Ultra is for everyone. Dedicated entrances, accessible viewing platforms and a team on site all weekend to make sure nothing gets between you and the music.

evidence.heading: Accessibility
evidence.text: This guide is intended to provide information regarding accessibility services available at the event. Guests with questions not addressed here are encouraged to contact us at [email protected] . We welcome feedback and will make reasonable efforts to accommodate accessibility needs.

evidence.heading: Wheelchairs
evidence.text: Ultra Music Festival is held at Bayfront Park, which includes a combination of grass, mulch, and paved surfaces. ADA-accessible routes connect entrances, stages, accessible viewing areas, vendors, and other key activity areas. VIP areas are accessible.

evidence.heading: Wheelchairs
evidence.text: Wheelchairs, motorized scooters, walkers, canes, and crutches are permitted. Ultra Music Festival does not provide wheelchair or scooter rentals.

evidence.heading: Wheelchairs
evidence.text: Limited charging access for powered mobility devices is available at the Accessibility Services Centers, subject to electrical infrastructure and safety limitations (110-volt, 20-amp circuit). Patrons should bring all cords, accessories, and compatible charges needed to charge their devices.

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: Ultra Music Festival does not provide parking. All parking in the surrounding area is privately operated or managed by City of Miami, and Ultra Music Festival has no control over availability, pricing, or accessible parking accommodation. There will be limited Accessible Parking spots for patrons with disabilities in proximity to the event, and are available on a first come, first served basis. Anyone parking in an Accessible Parking space is required to have a valid, state-issued disabled persons placard, permit, or license plate. The person to whom the credential is issued must be present in the vehicle, as a driver or passenger.

evidence.heading: Passenger loading zone
evidence.text: Ultra provides an Accessible Passenger Loading Zone for drop-off and pick-up located on the corner of Biscayne Blvd & Chopin Plaza (in front of the Intercontinental Hotel, just south of Bayfront Park), along with accessible routes and entrances to the venue. Drivers must present a valid handicap placard or plates to drop off guests in this zone.

evidence.heading: Entry
evidence.text: All entrances at Ultra Music Festival are accessible. In addition to the GA and VIP entrances, guests with disabilities can utilize the Accessibility / Ultra Passport Entrance. For ease of entry, we encourage guests with disabilities to utilize the Accessibility / Ultra Passport entrance located at Chopin Plaza on the South side of Bayfront Park, across from the Intercontinental Hotel. ADA wristbands are issued at this location. This wristband is free of charge and will grant you access to the accessibility services offered, including access to the Accessibility/Ultra Passport entrance. Patrons with disabilities and up to one companion may use this entrance to safely enter the venue.

evidence.heading: Official Policies
evidence.text: Newport Folk Festival allows ADA* recognized service animals trained specifically to assist a person with disabilities at all events. Animals whose sole function is to provide comfort or emotional support do not qualify as service animals under the ADA and are not permitted at the festivals. If you have a certified service animal, you will be required to have your service animal with you at all times. Under the ADA, service animals must be harnessed, leashed or tethered, unless these devices interfere with the service animal’s work or the individual’s disability prevents using these devices.

evidence.heading: Rice-Eccles Stadium
evidence.text: During home football games, guests with disabilities can park in any lot with a current ADA placard on a first-come, first-served basis at no cost. Guests with current ADA placards will need to park in the designated ADA stalls as all other stalls are reserved for Crimson Club donors. Once all ADA stalls are filled, parking staff will direct guests needing ADA parking to alternative areas/parking lots.

evidence.heading: Rice-Eccles Stadium
evidence.text: In addition to the designated ADA stalls in each parking lot, there will be 50 stalls reserved for ADA/Special Guests in Lot 5 (Campus Store) on a first-come, first-served basis at no cost. Guests will need to be able to get to the Stadium from this lot independently.

evidence.heading: Rice-Eccles Stadium
evidence.text: The Eccles Broadcast lot (Lot 27) will have 100 stalls reserved for guests with current ADA placards. The shuttle will run through the duration of the game and about an hour after the conclusion (or until shuttle platform is cleared).

evidence.heading: PROHIBITED ITEMS
evidence.text: Are service animals allowed in the venue? Only service animals are permitted at the Greek Theatre. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) defines a service animal as any dog, such as a guide dog or signal dog that is individually trained to provide assistance to an individual with a disability. This includes psychiatric service animals that are individually trained to provide service to individuals with psychiatric or neurological disabilities, such as preventing or interrupting impulsive or destructive behaviors. Service animals must be harnessed, leashed or tethered at all times, unless special circumstances exist, and will be required to rest in the seating area of the individual with a disability, rather than in the aisle. A guest whose service animal poses a threat to the safety of other guests and employees, or whose animal is not housebroken, may be asked to escort the animal off the premises.

evidence.heading: What is a Fast Lane Pass?
evidence.text: Fast Lane passes are an upgrade that you can purchase in addition to your general admission ticket. Fast Lane passes allow you to skip the general admission line and head straight to the doors when the venue opens. These are available online and can be purchased in a bundle with your GA ticket or as an add-on to your GA ticket at a later time. Fast Lane passes are available until doors open so please arrive before your show's scheduled door time to utilize your pass. Please note that these are not concert tickets; you still need a general admission ticket to enter the venue.

evidence.heading: My friend has tickets at Will Call but can’t make it to the show. Can I pick up their tickets and use them?
evidence.text: To change the pick-up name for Will Call tickets, your friend needs to go back to his or her original point of purchase. If the tickets were purchased online through our website, Live Nation, or Ticketmaster, they need to contact Ticketmaster directly at (800) 745-3000. If you are a radio contest winner, Premium Seating purchaser, or a guest of someone in the band, you’ll also need to reach out to your original contact and change your Will Call name that way. Please ensure that the name provided matches the name on the ID of whomever will be picking up the tickets.

evidence.heading: I think I'm on the Guest List, what do I need to do?
evidence.text: If you are on the HOUSE Guest List, your tickets will be available for pick up at the box office 30 minutes before doors. If you are on the ARTIST guest list, your tickets will be available once the house has been provided with the artist guest list; timing for this is at the discretion of the artist. You will need to go through the general admission line and security checkpoint first before you can head up to the box office and pick up your tickets. Please bring a valid photo ID with you and be sure to confirm with your contact prior to the show that your name is on the list to avoid any confusion at the box office.

These tickets may be picked up prior to the event at the Advanced Ticket Office during regular office hours or one (1) hour before the event at any of the ticket offices where the event is scheduled. evidence.heading: Ticket Information

When tickets are left by team players or touring personnel, the Ticket Office generally does not know the names for which the tickets will be left under until the actual tickets are dropped off at the Ticket Office. evidence.text: Bud Walton Express (Begins 90 min before tip) & Muss Bus (begins 2 hours before tip) There are two complimentary shuttle services for men’s basketball games. Route 81 will be named the “Bud Walton Express” and Route 82 is named the “Muss Bus.” (See below for diagrams of both routes.) • Both routes will drop off and pick up riders along Nolan Richardson Drive in front of Bud Walton Arena. • Both the “Bud Walton Express” and the “Muss Bus” are ADA compliant. • The “Bud Walton Express” (Route 81) will serve both the priority and public lots on the men’s basketball parking map and will take approximately 10 minutes to loop around. • The “Muss Bus” (Route 82) will serve more of a campus loop to include dorms on the north end of campus and sororities/fraternities on the east of campus as well as stops on Dickson Street and Union Station. This loop will take approximately 20 minutes. • Fans are highly encouraged the use of Lot 72 on the north side of the Frank Broyles Center at Razorback Stadium for convenient free public parking as well as additional ADA parking. The “Bud Walton Express” will pick up and drop off from Lot 44 on both Razorback Road and Stadium Drive.

Rideshare Drop-off and Pick-up Points A rideshare drop-off/pick up location will be located in front of the Jones Student-Athlete Success Center on Meadow Street for vehicles displaying Lyft or Uber signage.

SELF SCANNING TICKET All ticket holders will be able to scan their own tickets upon entry to Bud Walton Arena. Please present one ticket per person. Complete your downloading or transferring of mobile tickets BEFORE you arrive at the arena. This will eliminate the possibility that poor cell service/Wi-Fi prevent you from being able to access your tickets. If you need assistance accessing your mobile tickets please contact the Razorback Ticket Center at 479-575-5151 during business hours. If you need assistance accessing your mobile tickets on gameday , please visit the South Box Office at Bud Walton.

evidence.text: Infants ages 2 & under are admitted free to all regular season home events, except Football and Men’s Basketball, but must sit on an adult’s lap. evidence.heading: Accessible Seating
evidence.text: If tickets located in general seating areas need to be exchanged for accessible seats, a person must provide their tickets for exchange to the IU Athletics Ticket Office as soon as possible prior to the game to ensure them accessible seats with attendant seat(s). Another option is to exchange tickets on game day, if available, at the box office. Ticket exchanges are handled on a first-come, first-served basis.

evidence.heading: Duplicate Tickets
evidence.text: Ticket holders can access an electronic copy of tickets free of charge through the Indiana Hoosiers app on mobile device . Duplicate tickets will be issued to the ticket holder of record only and may be subject to a reprint fee. The Indiana Athletics Department is not responsible for lost or stolen tickets.
