evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ALCOHOL SALES – Fans are encouraged to verify their age prior to visiting a concessions stand. Age verification stations inside the stadium are centrally located on each concourse. Fans will receive an age verified wristband once approved. Subsequent ID checks are not required with a wristband. – You must be 21 to purchase alcohol. No exceptions. – A valid ID is required for every sale. – Limit two (2) drinks per transaction. – No sales or service to visibly intoxicated persons. – Underaged drinking is prohibited. – Purchasing or providing alcohol to minors is prohibited. – Guests who violate this policy may be ejected and risk arrest and loss of ticket privileges. – Sales will start when the gates or doors open. – Sales will end at the conclusion of the 3rd quarter

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: BASICS – Stadium gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff – Smoking is prohibited on the campus of the University of Mississippi including in and around Vaught-Hemingway Stadium. – In case of an emergency inside Vaught-Hemingway Stadium please dial 911 or text “REBS”, the issue and the location to 662-291-7242. – Security office is located on the ground level in the southeast corner of the stadium near gate 20. – First Aid stations are located inside Vaught-Hemingway Stadium on the lower level of the east side near section K, the lower level of the southeast corner near gate 20 and the middle concourse of the west side near section J. – Abusive language is prohibited. – Throwing of objects onto the field/stage is prohibited. – Lost and found articles should be turned into ushers and/or security personnel. Items may be claimed by visiting the security station located on the ground level of the southeast corner of the stadium, or after the game by contacting the University Police Department. – State law prohibits scalping tickets at events hosted by the University of Mississippi. (MS Code Ann. 97-23-97). – No reentry after you are scanned into the stadium

evidence.heading: L
evidence.text: LOST AND FOUND – Lost and found articles should be reported to the security agent at the media entrance by the elevators on the west side. Any items not picked up will be taken to the University Police Department. To claim a lost item from UPD, please fill out and submit the Lost Property Form at https://olemiss.edu/upd/police-services/lost-property-form/ . If your item is at UPD, the Lost Property Custodian will contact you within three to five business days to schedule an appointment for pickup.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ADA PARKING – Fans must have a valid Ole Miss gameday parking pass AND a state-issued ADA credential to park in ADA stalls during athletics events. – Fans must display a state-issued ADA parking credential any time you park in stalls marked with ADA signage on the Ole Miss Campus and off-campus shuttle lots. – Violators are subject to citation and tow. – All ADA signage and markings are honored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on the Ole Miss campus and off-campus shuttle lots. Please do not park in an ADA stall when parking for athletics events unless you have a state-issued ADA hang tag or license plate along with your gameday parking pass. – The Americans with Disabilities Act prohibits the refusal of service to any patron seeking service. Therefore, fans are asked to be courteous to those requiring service and to not use the ADA shuttles unless needed. – ADA Golf Carts are located on the Southeast and Northeast sides of the stadium. – If you need assistance for a shuttle, please call 662-915-7235.

evidence.heading: the apollo Stages At The Victoria
evidence.text: Both Theater 1 and the Jonelle Procope Theater (Procope Theater) are fully wheelchair accessible via elevator. The venue entrance is step-free, though it does not feature automatic doors. An elevator services all public floors, including access to both theaters and restrooms. There are three restrooms in total: one men’s, one women’s, and one single-use gender-neutral restroom. All are ADA-compliant and include baby-changing stations. Assistive Listening Devices are available upon request. Guests may email access@apollotheater.org in advance or ask for the House Manager upon arrival. ASL interpretation can be arranged with at least two months’ advance notice by contacting the same email. ADA-recognized service animals are welcome. There are no on-site relief areas; patrons must exit the venue if needed. Accessible seating is available for all performances and can be requested during the ticketing process (Ticketmaster) or by visiting the Box Office.

evidence.heading: How do you get to Carnegie Hall?
evidence.text: The answer to this question inspired a well-known joke. The punch line is often attributed to violinist Jascha Heifetz or pianist Arthur Rubinstein, sometimes to an anonymous musician or taxi driver, and once even to a beatnik, who, in a 1960 telling, replied “Practice, man, practice.” At some point, the line was given a triple flourish: “Practice, practice, practice.”

evidence.heading: Is there a coat check?
evidence.text: Coat checks are available for your convenience at every Carnegie Hall performance in Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage and Zankel Hall. You are invited—but not required—to check coats, scarves, and other small personal belongings. A $2 fee applies for each checked item. Larger items must be checked before you are seated, subject to venue policies. For performances in Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage, the coat check is located on the west side of the Box Office lobby. For performances in Zankel Hall, the coat check is located on the Parterre level.

evidence.text: Whether you’re attending one of our world-class performances, planning a night out, or just visiting while you’re in New York City, there’s always something to do at Carnegie Hall—both on stage and off. evidence.heading: WHAT TYPE OF TICKETING OPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE?
evidence.text: DO YOU HAVE A BOX OFFICE? Yes! We are excited to say we have box office hours every week, where you’ll have the ability to purchase reduced-fee tickets. We know the ticketing landscape is challenging, but we’re hopeful this will help make the purchasing process less painful and more manageable. To make sure we’re getting these tickets into the hands of our true Salt Shed fans, all ticket purchases made for these reduced-fee tickets at our box office will be limited to two (2) tickets per person. If we suspect the purchaser intends to resell these tickets, we do reserve the right to refuse service to this individual. We have regular box office hours any night there is a show at The Salt Shed, from venue door time until the end of the show. In addition to our regular box office hours on show nights, we will have our box office open every Friday from 9:30am to 2:00pm. Our box office is located near 1200 W Blackhawk, which is located by the main gate at the Salt Shed.

evidence.heading: FAQs
evidence.text: I have “Will Call” tickets, what does that mean? Can you send me my tickets in advance instead? “Will Call” tickets are those that are designated for pick-up at the venue on the day of the event, rather than being sent in advance. Unfortunately, tickets that are designated as “Will Call” are not transferable and can only be picked up by the person whose name is on the ticket w/ ID. This is a security measure to ensure that only the person who purchased the tickets is able to attend the event. We can not change the delivery method / re-issue tickets electronically. We understand that it can be inconvenient to pick up your tickets at the venue on the day of the show. However, we typically do not have long lines for Will Call ticket pickup (typically less than 50 customers throughout the night) and our staff is well-trained and efficient at getting customers their tickets quickly. You can pick up your Will Call tickets starting two hours before doors open (usually at 5pm) on the day of the event.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
evidence.text: All patrons, regardless of age, are required to have a ticket in order to enter the venue. Certain shows have age restrictions (typically 16 & Up or 18 & Up) which means you must be that age or older on the date of the show, and be prepared to show photo ID at the door. Patrons without photo ID or who do not meet the age requirement will be denied entry to the venue without refund. Exceptions are on a case-by-case basis, and at the discretion of theatre management. If you anticipate an issue with your ticket for an age restricted show, please contact our box office in advance to discuss possible solutions. Most events are not suitable for young children. While we believe a child should be exposed to live performances, we are mindful of other patrons’ enjoyment as well. Therefore, we ask parental discretion in bringing small children and infants. Should a child be unable to sit quietly in his/her own seat throughout a performance, our event staff may request that the child and accompanying adult be asked to leave the theatre.

evidence.heading: Accessibility – United States
evidence.text: Accessibility Statement – United States

evidence.heading: Accessibility Statement – United States
evidence.text: ATG Entertainment is committed to maintaining compliant websites and online services, and to providing an online environment that is accessible to all visitors. This commitment aligns with Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act (29 U.S.C. §794d), and applicable implementing regulations, as well as the recommendations outlined in the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

evidence.heading: Accessibility Statement – United States
evidence.text: We use industry-standard accessibility methods and tools to achieve this. For example, the UserWay Website Accessibility Widget, available on our Sites(s), is powered by a dedicated accessibility server. The widget provides user-triggered enhancements that allow visitors to improve the site’s accessibility. When selected, these features can increase font size, pause animations, adjust colour contrast, and more. Users can choose combinations that best suit their needs, in line with WCAG Level AAA guidelines.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Statement – United States
evidence.text: Additionally, we enable Automated Remediation Technology (ART) for all visitors. ART does not detect the use of assistive technologies; rather, it enhances accessibility for all site visitors by deploying remediation capabilities. These methods comply with the applicable version of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) established by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), the primary international standards organization for the internet.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Statement – United States
evidence.text: As part of our commitment to accessibility, we also partner with Audioeye to ensure our continued compliance. Through this partnership, we have conducted and continue to conduct accessibility audits of our online services, and have remediated, and continue to remediate any issues identified during these audits.

evidence.heading: Accessibility Statement – United States
evidence.text: For certain events, ATG Entertainment is not the main ticket provider, and tickets may come from third-party sellers. Because of this, we can’t guarantee that accessible tickets will appear for resale or in subscriptions. If you need accessible seating for these events, we recommend reaching out to the primary ticket seller or the venue box office to check what’s available.

evidence.heading: Web accessibility
evidence.text: We are committed to providing a smooth, inclusive experience. If any part of this website is inaccessible to you, please contact us at [email protected] . We value all feedback and welcome suggestions that help us continue improving our digital accessibility efforts. We will take all reasonable steps to ensure any feedback is addressed.

evidence.text: Yes, there is a cloakroom at all events. On the first floor (accessible from the foyer) there are self-service lockers where you can leave jackets and other items. The price is CHF 04.00 per locker and there is room for about two “normal” jackets in one locker.

evidence.heading: General
evidence.text: In accordance with Section 1 of the Swiss Federal Act on Protection against Passive Smoking, the Hallenstadion is classed as a publicly accessible space, so smoking is prohibited throughout the entire venue.

evidence.heading: Cloakroom / banned items
evidence.text: – All drinks in glass bottles, cans, PET bottles and Tetra Pak containers – Aerosol cans, colouring, corrosive or otherwise harmful substances – Food of any kind – Drugs – Liquids in glass vessels, cans or other containers – Professional cameras, video cameras and recording devices of any kind, selfie sticks – Laptops, tablets – Weapons of all kinds, objects that could be used as weapons or projectiles, laser pointers – Large sports bags, holdalls or large rucksacks (bigger than 21 x 29.7 cm) – Sports equipment such as roller skates or scooters – Banners, signs larger than A2 size or flags with a pole length of over 1 metre – Fireworks, sparklers, smoke flares and other pyrotechnic items, including launching devices – Animals – Objects, items of clothing and/or media with racist, xenophobic, violent or discriminatory prints or content This list is not exhaustive and may be added to at the event organiser’s discretion. Prohibited items can be deposited for a fee at drop-off points next to both main entrances on Wallisellenstrasse. For more information, please see our Stadium rules .

evidence.heading: Accessibility
evidence.text: The L’Olympia team is committed to welcoming all audiences under the best possible conditions. If you have a disability, use a wheelchair, have obesity, or experience temporary mobility limitations, please refer to our Accessibility page.

evidence.heading: Prepare your visit to L’Olympia
evidence.text: As soon as the doors open, the bars within L’Olympia are available with a selection of drinks. Discover our beer, champagne, wine, soft drinks, fruit juice, snacks and sandwichs menu.

evidence.heading: What is permitted and what is prohibited
evidence.text: You may leave the hall after entry; however, please note that all exits are final and re-entry will not be allowed.

evidence.heading: Box offices opening hours & contact
evidence.text: You can also pick up tickets purchased on our website using the “Pick up at the box office” method, from the day after your reservation until the evening of the show, with your purchase confirmation and ID.

evidence.heading: Reservations & Tickets
evidence.text: Box office pickup: Your tickets can be collected starting the day after your reservation and up until the evening of the show. You must present your purchase confirmation and a valid ID. Another person may collect the tickets on your behalf, provided they present a written and signed authorization letter from the original purchaser, along with a copy of the purchaser’s ID and their own.

evidence.heading: Reservations & Tickets
evidence.text: You will not be refunded for the cost of obtaining your ticket (€1.80 for an e-ticket, €3 for a physical ticket, €6 for pickup at the box office, and €9–€15 for home delivery).

evidence.heading: 2. Box office
evidence.text: The purchase of a ticket constitutes acceptance of The Olympia’s House Rules, which are displayed at the venue entrance and published on its website. It also constitutes acceptance of the event organizer’s regulations, where applicable. By purchasing a ticket, customers agree to comply with all provisions of these House Rules.

evidence.heading: 3. Safety and regulations

evidence.heading: 1. Personal data and information collected
evidence.text: When you purchase a ticket, you enter into a contract with us. In order to be able to execute this contract, we collect your personal data which enables us to manage your ticket order: payment processing, ticket delivery, invoicing, sending of the confirmation e-mail, customer service, communication of information about the Event, communication of information and reimbursement in the event of cancellation or postponement of the Event, export of data for access control at the entrance to the Event, etc. The name and surname of a member of our staff may be used for this purpose. The surname and first name of a ticket holder may be different from those of the purchaser of the order. For this reason, we advise you to obtain his or her prior consent to communicate this information, since we need to process it for the purposes described above.
